6a5191d8fa9f9f7a09081789.synopsis: Elijah Baran is a genie in a magic lamp who can grant three wishes. After thousands of years, a billionaire uses his last wish to grant Elijah freedom, but on one condition: Elijah must marry his granddaughter, Christine, for five years! To fulfill the wish, Elijah transforms into a human, marries Christine, and secretly helps her become a successful CEO. However, Christine ignores and constantly belittles him during their marriage. When the five years are almost up, Elijah starts to realize that Christine might never truly love him. He decides to divorce her.
6a5191d8fa9f9f7a09081789.title: The Great and Powerful Genie

6a544e264e8edf02280ca29d.synopsis: Khloe has always played by the rules until her sister's life depends on money she doesn't have. So she signs the unthinkable: marry ruthless billionaire Jasper Tate, give him the heir his empire demands, and walk away rich. No feelings. No complications. Just business.Khloe has always played by the rules until her sister's life depends on money she doesn't have. So she signs the unthinkable: marry ruthless billionaire Jasper Tate, give him the heir his empire demands, and walk away rich. No feelings. No complications. Just business. But Jasper never expected his fake wife to get under his skin. And Khloe never planned to want a man she's only pretending to love. The contract had one rule — don't fall in love. Breaking it could cost them everything.
6a544e264e8edf02280ca29d.title: A Marriage Deal with the Billionaire

6a547c258e7dc74d870b30af.synopsis: In The Valkyrie Divorces the God of War movie, to protect his wife, God King Kairos sealed his divine powers and feigned being a worthless mortal. Instead of gratitude, Cassia returned bearing her lover's child, demanding the family relic while humiliating him publicly. Driven past his limit, Kairos shattered his shackles, awakening his supreme godhood. He exposed her lover as an abyssal spy, leading to the traitor's execution. Begging for mercy, Cassia fled in exile, as the God King reclaimed his absolute throne.
6a547c258e7dc74d870b30af.title: The Valkyrie Divorces the God of War

6a547dbf24890ff5cd06e619.synopsis: Iris’s mother, who had immigrated to the United States from Thailand as part of a blended family, died in a car accident along with her American husband while they were on their way to get married. Unwilling to see Iris deported, her stepfather’s son, Leon, dropped out of school to work on a construction site and shoulder the financial burden; as they relied on each other, the two grew close. After graduating from high school, Iris was accepted into a New York law school, just as she had hoped. Leon promised to join her, but on the very last day, he was involved in an accident at the construction site, and the two lost contact. Five years later, Iris joined a top-tier law firm, and Leon walked through the doors as a billionaire client—reuniting the two.
6a547dbf24890ff5cd06e619.title: The Boy Raised Me is Mine

6a54aab7320378451205e865.synopsis: When her childhood best friend Leo ties her to the school goalpost as a prank to impress another girl, Eleanor Vance transfers to a California high school to start over. As she heals, excels academically, and finds new love, Leo spirals into regret—but some betrayals can never be undone.
6a54aab7320378451205e865.title: He Pulled a Prank on Me and Lost Everything

6a54dceea398b25e350d0c8b.synopsis: Ava Russell on the eve of her arranged marriage, is drugged by her fiancé Nico Moretti and has her hair brutally shaved off by his comrade Scarlett. Refusing to swallow this humiliation, Ava secretly contacts Damian Costello, the powerful heir of the Costello family who has secretly loved her for twelve years. On the wedding day, when Nico tries to sneak Ava into his family through a shabby, hidden ceremony and Scarlett publicly strips off her wig to mock her, Damian arrives with a magnificent fleet to marry Ava in style. With the help of Damian and the Commission, Nico and Scarlett are stripped of their power and arrested for violating family laws, while Ava finally finds her true protector and happiness.
6a54dceea398b25e350d0c8b.title: His Partner, Her Revenge

6a55cba42bfaaef26f0f5299.synopsis: Wren is labeled wolfless and abandoned by her childhood lover Tristan at his coronation, who publicly rejects their mate bond and lets his lover cut her hair. Heartbroken, she leaves the Dark Moon pack and enters the elite Apex Academy. There, she awakens the rare powerful White Wolf bloodline hidden inside her. With the quiet Frost heir Killian's support, Wren defeats rivals, uncovers Vaelen's evil plot that preys on wolfkin's blood power, and rescues her dad. She stands side by side with Killian to build a new order where no one is forced to kneel for power.
6a55cba42bfaaef26f0f5299.title: The Lycan's Savage Luna

6a56dd826a410e5f5d04c33b.synopsis: In Zero to Alpha Return of the Wolf King movie, exiled for failing to awaken his wolf form, Nory trained twenty years under three Masters beyond Sacred Rank. Returning to see his mother, he enters the Clan Tournament, shatters the test stone, crushes every foe, and is revealed as the savior three Gold Leaders sought. When vampires invade, he slams the Legendary First Sire through seven walls. Learning his mother was injured saving him, he gathers three sacred relics to heal her. But crimson eyes in distant mist hint a greater threat.
6a56dd826a410e5f5d04c33b.title: Zero to Alpha: Return of the Wolf King

6a575df904e2a3e52d00406b.synopsis: One drunken night, one humiliating ex, fake-date her worst enemy Blake or watch the Greenharts lose every point because of her. Hannah signs the contract expecting torture. Instead, she finds the cold, untouchable rival everyone fears has a side no one's ever seen, fiercely protective, quietly devoted, and hiding a secret of his own. When the pretending stops feeling like pretending, is it still an act? Then her ex Tristan discovers the truth—Hannah is Miss H, the anonymous genius the whole school idolizes. Now he's on his knees, begging for a second chance. Two boys, one choice.
6a575df904e2a3e52d00406b.title: The Fake Dating Spell

6a580b359cc3a55a2b08ad6d.synopsis: She came to town for a fresh start. Instead, Penelope Harris got pregnant by her ex’s powerful older brother, Knox Grant– the rugged cowboy who owns the ranch where she works. Now Penelope is caught between the man who would burn the world down for her and her ex, who wants to see her burn.
6a580b359cc3a55a2b08ad6d.title: Keeping the Cowboy's Baby

6a580e0abaa3c12b130cb57d.synopsis: In How to Wreck My Bully's Heart movie, Kristina Cooper's a scholarship student by day, online masked singer by night. She's got the perfect internet boyfriend in Dax – sweet, caring, and supportive – until she finds out he's Daxter, the monsterous thug who's been bullying her at school! Will she forgive Dexter, the damaged, broken boy she once loved, or will their anonymous love end in Dexter's never ending regret as Kristina choses a brighter future without him?
6a580e0abaa3c12b130cb57d.title: How to Wreck My Bully's Heart

6a598bdc118ac35b290f065a.synopsis: I‘m Elowen, the only rabbit shifter with purifying blood, destined to be Alpha King Kael’s Luna. But on our bonding altar, he brought his pregnant snake mistress, ordering me to raise their child as their servant. I revoked our bond and offered myself to any shifter willing to claim me. Everyone feared Kael—until cursed, discarded Prince Rowan stepped forward. I chose him, my pure blood suppressing his deadly curse. The old prophecy shifted to us. Kael lost all power and begged me back, while his serpent lover sank into dark corruption. Can Rowan and I stop the feral beast tide sweeping the realm?
6a598bdc118ac35b290f065a.title: The Rabbit Bride Who Rejected Her Alpha King

6a598bde89a94812de0b87db.synopsis: On her big day, she caught her fiancé with her best friend in bed. Furious, she married a random guy on the spot. But guess what? this "nobody" was her ex's uncle—and the richest man alive!
6a598bde89a94812de0b87db.title: Married Ex-Fiancé's Uncle

6a5d84c66c05476ac30ef75f.synopsis: Emma is alone after her husband leaves on a mafia mission, trapped by a painful blocked milk duct and a crying baby. Then Dante Vella, her husband’s wounded mafia boss, breaks into her home, hiding from killers outside. To keep the baby quiet, Emma has no choice but to let him help relieve her most private pain. But his steady hands and dangerous closeness awaken feelings she should never have. When her husband suddenly video-calls, Dante stays just outside the frame, his hand moving from the ache he was supposed to soothe toward the shadow beneath her skirt. As her husband talks about hunting Dante for a bounty, Emma realizes the real danger is no longer outside the door.
6a5d84c66c05476ac30ef75f.title: The Mafia Boss My Husband Betrayed

6a5db4b9d2d51395fd03a48b.synopsis: After being betrayed by her Alpha mate and watching him lead the pack to slaughter both her and her newborn daughter, Lyra is given a second life. This time, she rejects fate, chooses a new mate, and awakens the legendary White Wolf. As the truth behind the pureblood bloodline unravels, the Alpha realizes he destroyed the very bloodline his family hunted for generations. But when Lyra becomes pregnant again, the hunt begins once more.
6a5db4b9d2d51395fd03a48b.title: I Married the Alpha They Threw Away

6a5db4bdb72949b20d0fdcb9.synopsis: Aria Voss lost her voice and scarred her face dragging Alpha Damon Kade out of a wolfsbane fire. Three years later, Damon believes Vivienne, the woman wearing Aria's stolen pendant, is his savior. He calls Aria a liar, gives her to his warriors as a reward, and ties her to the border for execution. Aria has no voice, no wolf, and no pack left to trust. Then Frostfang's Caleb cuts her free. With her voice returning and her pendant back in hand, Aria walks into Blackthorn as Ravyn Vale to expose the fraud and reject the Alpha who ruined her.
6a5db4bdb72949b20d0fdcb9.title: The Alpha Made His Savior the Pack's Slave

6a5db5613d1410127c0846fb.synopsis: Minutes before her engagement, Manhattan's richest heiress catches her fiancé in bed with the scholarship student she personally sponsored. He humiliates her in front of the entire city, believing love has finally defeated money. Instead of begging, Sera unleashes the contracts that built his empire. Frozen assets, federal investigations, and billion-dollar lawsuits turn his dream into a nightmare. But when he realizes the woman he betrayed was the only reason he ever stood at the top, it is already too late.
6a5db5613d1410127c0846fb.title: My Fiancé Betrayed Me, So I Bankrupted Him

6a60170b103930ddda06a0a9.synopsis: Karter, the legendary Poker King lost everything when he reported Aaron for money laundering 3 years ago. He was rescued by Elena, the daughter of a small casino's owner. When Aaron returns to put Elena and the casino in danger, Karter gives up his disguise as a humble waiter, and reveals his true identity.
6a60170b103930ddda06a0a9.title: The Poker King Returns

6a601869953a7d189a0267a9.synopsis: Lucas Thorne, a powerful demigod disguised as a beggar finally finds love with a mafia heiress who accepts him at his lowest—but when danger closes in, he must reveal his true identity to protect her, risking the secret he was bound to keep.
6a601869953a7d189a0267a9.title: Her Man Is the Son of Death

6a60312dd082ebff8b06879a.synopsis: “Did you get rejected?!” My sister Jade laughs at me. “I knew it! I told you that you would. No one would ever want you. A wolfless. But I’m more surprised that you, of all people, found a fated mate. Kind of unfair if you ask me.” It stings to hear this. It’s exactly what happened. She was right. “Well, let’s not let this bring us down.” Mother smiles and claps. “It’s been decided that Jade is to be mated to the fourth wolf prince. ” Jade smirks. “One of the bastard illegitimate princes, but I’m not complaining.” She smiles with pride. “He’s still a prince.” The crowd suddenly grow noisy. The princes arrive. “Alpha Prince Dorian, the fourth prince, Antonio the fifth, and Emmet the sixth—all of them illegitimate.” All three men wave with broad smiles. Suddenly, another man hurries past them. “That’s Alpha Prince Raphael! Second born to a true royal‑blooded Luna.” The stunning blond man—his hair lighter than even my mother’s or sister’s—strides forward with an imposing pace. His bright blue eyes gleam beneath the black suit and satin shirt, half‑unbuttoned to reveal the edge of his tattoos. I freeze as his gaze locks onto mine. Time itself seems to stop, because that man… is him. The one who broke my heart. The one who rejected me. The one who shattered our bond. My fated mate.
6a60312dd082ebff8b06879a.title: The Raven Wolf King: Wolfless

6a6031b6939b5006a8001c1b.synopsis: Asher secretly dated QB Chase for six months. Chase never went public—instead he played the perfect couple with Asher's sister Daisy. A naked photo of Asher leaked across campus. Daisy stole it from Chase's phone. Chase told Asher to stay quiet and kept using him. Hockey captain Finn opened Instagram in front of everyone: “Want to date? Follow me first.” Next day, he held Asher's hand in the hallway—fingers laced, for everyone to see. Daisy faked a nut allergy attack to frame Asher. Asher shoved her head into a fountain. Chase lost his game and screamed at Daisy on the sideline—his golden image shattered. Finn won, looked at the camera, and said: “Our goalie held two periods alone. I didn't want him carrying it alone anymore.” Everyone understood.
6a6031b6939b5006a8001c1b.title: The Boy the QB Used in Bed

6a6035c0f2b19bb318052a0b.synopsis: I ran from my arranged wedding after catching my fiancé in bed with another woman. That same night, I lost my virginity to a stranger—only to discover he was my fiancé all along. When I became pregnant, he looked me in the eye and said, “Get rid of the baby.” I walked away for good... until his powerful rival offered me a new life. Now two mafia heirs are fighting for me, but only one deserves my heart. The problem? The man who broke me refuses to let me go.
6a6035c0f2b19bb318052a0b.title: Two Mafia Bosses Begging Me For Love

6a6059c96a805ace3109c7e6.synopsis: When a future version of her rival crashes into the present with a terrifying warning, motocross star Tessa learns that falling in love with Riggs Heartstone will end in tragedy. Now she's stuck as his racing partner, fighting their chemistry while racing toward the biggest competition of her life. But the harder she tries to save him, the harder she falls.
6a6059c96a805ace3109c7e6.title: Boyfriend from the Future

6a6095f6d9ab3292c807c4ff.synopsis: She discovers her mob boss husband's affair and loses one of her twin babies due to his adopted sister's schemes. She reports him to the authorities and flees while still pregnant. Seven years later, she runs into him on the street. She thinks her murderous husband is going to kill her, but when he drags her back home against her will, she realizes the truth. Seven years ago, it was all a misunderstanding. The ruthless mafia boss only wants one thing—to win her love back.
6a6095f6d9ab3292c807c4ff.title: Torn Between the Mafia Twins

6a616fcbc063a1f59108d8ca.synopsis: Exiled half-beast prince Cassian storms back from the dead, slaughters his father, and seizes the throne in a bloodbath. His first prey, Vera, the ice-cold former queen. The woman who crushed their love for a crown, married his father, and cast him into the beast pit to rot. Consumed by rage, the ruthless new king forces his stepmother into his bed as his personal captive and swears to kill Lucian, Vera's royal son with the dead king. Then a bombshell drops. His so-called half-brother shares his rare, exclusive beast blood. Vera has hidden the truth of Lucian's identity.
6a616fcbc063a1f59108d8ca.title: Crowned in His Claws

6a6175020e58adb4bc0cafae.synopsis: In 2006, Marcel "The Sniper" Wallace wins THE LEAGUE title, then loses his wife to rival Tyler Murray's hitman. He vanishes into a fast-food job for twenty years. Lured back as coach, he reunites with his resentful son Mars, a LEAGUE star. Marcel proves himself through impossible shots while Murray escalates to kidnapping and blackmail. At the Hall of Fame, Marcel reveals his identity and Murray confesses to murder. Victory comes when Mars accepts twenty unsent birthday letters and they embrace.
6a6175020e58adb4bc0cafae.title: Full Court Legend

6a617638677231413606d68b.synopsis: Ravena Mooncrest, secret Wolf Queen, has her wolf sealed so that she can runaway with her fated mate, Alpha Draven Nightfang. But Draven mistakes the birthmark on their son to mean Ravena cheated and makes them his slaves. Only when the life of their son is threatened, is there a chance for Draven to realize the truth, but will it be too late then?
6a617638677231413606d68b.title: You Betrayed the Wrong Alpha Queen

6a62971687b70290eb03ff9a.synopsis: In Marry Me Twice, Mr. Grant movie, everyone's always told Nora to keep her head down and stay silent, but there's one exception — Vince Grant, her husband. As their contract marriage comes to an end after the best year of her life, Nora is faced with returning to her abusive family, who are already plotting to marry her off again. Always the calm, collected CEO, Vince finds himself desperate for a chance to win Nora over, even though she left him without looking back. He watches Nora shrink back into the shell he spent a year coaxing her out of, and decides enough is enough. Whether it's as the best "ex-husband" the world's ever seen, or Nora's real husband, with no contract between them, he'll protect her with everything he has.
6a62971687b70290eb03ff9a.title: Marry Me Twice, Mr. Grant

6a629f5ea1c787017500913a.synopsis: A lifetime ago, figure skating prodigy Gwen Tyler was at the top of her game and on her way to Olympic gold. But ten years later, she's stuck in a loveless engagement and a shadow of her former self. Then, her childhood best friend Aaron Lansing comes back into her life after a decade apart, and Gwen starts to realize... maybe the love she's been missing is the one she had when she was eighteen. Now she has to decide whether she's just going to keep letting life happen to her, or take back control for herself.
6a629f5ea1c787017500913a.title: Take Me Back to the Night We Met

6a62a25bff3dc346ee01104a.synopsis: In Honey-Trapped My Fiancé's Billionaire Rival movie, after ten years of loving Ryan, Jade Gray is asked to seduce his billionaire rival, Asher Blackwood, to help save Ryan’s first love, Eleanor. But Asher secretly has feelings for Jade, turning Ryan’s carefully planned scheme into a dangerous love triangle. As Jade grows closer to Asher, she begins to question who truly deserves her love.
6a62a25bff3dc346ee01104a.title: Honey-Trapped My Fiancé's Billionaire Rival

6a631d4b7f6e39aad1061157.synopsis: Leo, the legendary surfing champion, loses his title to a mysterious newcomer named Ruslan. But the biggest shock comes when he discovers that Ruslan is the man from his unforgettable night. Forced into an uneasy partnership, the two rivals find themselves drawn to each other as secrets, danger, and betrayal close in. Behind their battle for glory lies a hidden truth about Ruslan—and their forbidden desire has only just begun...
6a631d4b7f6e39aad1061157.title: Caught in His Current

6a63772975b2eafae30ae379.synopsis: Reese Calder orders a custom companion android, 006, with the face of Nolan Vance, her spoiled, maddening lifelong rival. By day, 006 cooks, cleans, and kneels when she says, "Down." By night, he breaks every command and makes her forget he is supposed to be a machine. Then Kindred Care texts: "Your companion hasn't shipped yet." Nolan calls it a prank. Miles calls it suicide: "If Reese finds the truth, you're done." But Reese finds the truth anyway, and now the liar is still kneeling.
6a63772975b2eafae30ae379.title: My Sex Robot Has My Enemy's Face

6a66b7bd7fa17f5a6102246c.synopsis: Cora took in three wounded wolves and raised them. The moment her sister Vivian appeared, the wolves couldn't look away—they turned cold and rough, trying to break Cora. She overheard them mocking her. So she offered a trade: three wolves for Vivian's snake. Silas the snake was ice-cold, yet he stayed—doing chores, guarding her. When her family forced an arranged marriage, Cora faked agreement, then fled through a window on her wedding day. Silas tracked her to the airport, injuring two wolves who tried to stop him. “You'll never get rid of me,” he said. Cora took over the family business and bonded with Silas. The cold snake was truer than any wolf.
6a66b7bd7fa17f5a6102246c.title: Traded My Wolves for a Snake

6a66b7bf7fa17f5a6102246f.synopsis: On the night before her engagement, Celeste Yarrow is locked inside a rooftop glass greenhouse by Ingrid Sloane, drenched in freezing water while the guests film and laugh. Damien Thorne, the man she spent three years saving, refuses to protect her and even exposes her deepest trauma for Ingrid’s amusement. Everyone thinks Celeste is just a small-town woman clinging to power, but she is the real force behind Yarrow Capital and the projects that made Thorne rise. After shattering the glass cage herself, Celeste cancels the engagement, pulls her investment, releases the evidence, and makes every betrayer pay.
6a66b7bf7fa17f5a6102246f.title: The Glass Cage

6a66b7c17fa17f5a61022472.synopsis: Xanthea Plath, an illegitimate child of the Alpha of Virgo pack, was an omega and omegas weren't allowed to dream, yet she never stopped dreaming. She wanted to be a doctor just like her mother but the luna of the pack, her stepmother would break her physically and mentally and stop at nothing to crush all her dreams. Xanthea had still found a way though all the abuse her steps put her through. But one day her world came crashing down right before her entrance in a medical college when she found out that she was being offered as a bride to the ruthless triplet alphas also known as the demon lords of the Infernal pack of the underworld. Xanthea had heard the horrifying stories of several suitors who had come before her, all of whom had met a gruesome end.
6a66b7c17fa17f5a61022472.title: Offered to the triplet Alpha

6a670d5c4fc3fdef560395e8.synopsis: Tessa’s crush throws her cinnamon roll in the trash and calls her a fat pig in front of the whole class. When she finally stops begging to be chosen, she starts glowing up and catches everyone’s eye, including the boy who destroyed her. But Tessa has already chosen Adrian, the masked outcast everyone calls scarred and pathetic. By the time Chase wants her back, Adrian’s secret is out: he was never weak. He was the richest, most dangerous boy in the room.
6a670d5c4fc3fdef560395e8.title: The Ugly Girl Turned Pretty

6a672bc50dc68f56a409f670.synopsis: In Sold to the Warlord Born for the Sky movie, a sheltered northern princess who was sold into marriage to the dragon-riding warlord of the brutal Blackclaw horde must decide whether surrendering to the man who bought her is her greatest betrayal or the only thing that can save her dying people.
6a672bc50dc68f56a409f670.title: Sold to the Warlord, Born for the Sky

6a6733958d893bb4600e0595.synopsis: Erin Vance’s 18th wedding anniversary turns into a nightmare when she discovers her husband Derek cheating with her best friend Sofia. Betrayed and abandoned, Erin is forced to start over with nothing. With help from Gavin Bower, she enters the “Miss Intercontinental” contest and rises from a housewife to a champion through her talent and determination. Defeating Sofia and exposing her scandals, Erin rebuilds her life. Gavin, secretly the president of K Group, supports her while letting her prove herself. After overcoming betrayal and danger, Erin regains her dignity and begins a new chapter with Gavin.
6a6733958d893bb4600e0595.title: I Became the CEO's Most Beloved

6a67cca11ec24d81c80639bc.synopsis: Based on the novel by Cora Reilly. As the heir to the Chicago mafia, Dante is logical to a fault. The only thing Valentina has in common with him is being a widow. When Dante chooses her as his next wife, it's a business decision made by a man still haunted from losing the love of his life. But Valentina won't repeat the lovelessness of her first marriage. As she struggles with her own desire for her new husband, little does she know -- his heart may have already started beating for her.
6a67cca11ec24d81c80639bc.title: Bound by Duty

6a67d06112cc28505607205a.synopsis: In God of Pain movie, a sheltered mafia princess tries to escape an arranged marriage, only to fall for the school’s most dangerous bad boy. But he refuses to love her… Until he can’t let her go.
6a67d06112cc28505607205a.title: God of Pain

6a680a0ee4b3871eb50e9f9b.synopsis: Isabella gave up her secret life as the leader of the legendary Shadow Circle to be with her beloved mate, whom she works hard as an herbalist to support. But when he's promoted to Alpha's General, instead of thanking her, he breaks their mate bond and replaces her with a scheming Commander's Daughter. He's not expecting the Alpha himself to show up and reveal Isabella is the lost wolf princess — destined to be Alpha Queen — and he'll regret letting her go.
6a680a0ee4b3871eb50e9f9b.title: She Bows for No One

6a6848570706aa908c0a81f9.synopsis: Luca Conri is the wolf-less runt of the Nightreign Pack, whose bark is bigger than his bite. Tormented by his own pack and hunted by rivals, Luca is reluctantly put under the protection of his dominant Alpha, and older brother's best friend, Dalton. However, everything changes when the two become fated mates, a bond that violates the natural order of the pack. As enemies close in and traditions try to tear them apart, Luca and Dalton must decide if they want to give into their lustful temptations in a forbidden romance that threatens their own lives.
6a6848570706aa908c0a81f9.title: Fated to His Brother's Alpha

6a68491f7434a5b9ed0f8045.synopsis: “It’s just a formality.” Reynolds threw those words in Eliot’s face on their wedding day, leaving him behind to greet his comrade. Four years of lies, another Alpha’s scent on Reynolds’ skin.Eliot didn’t cry. He ripped off his ring, threw it at Reynolds’ feet, and walked into the hall across.Vaughn had been waiting there for four years. White roses. Starlight lamps. A ring he’d kept since they were kids. He spent four years climbing four ranks just to rewrite the law that locked Omegas out of the mech bay. He never told Eliot. He just pried the door open and waited.
6a68491f7434a5b9ed0f8045.title: The Alpha Commander’s Long-Awaited Omega

6a686012cd3a8257390f38c9.synopsis: At Waverly University, the ice rink is split in two: on one side, the hockey team trains with brutal intensity; on the other, the figure skating team glides through elegant routines. Abby Williams is the golden girl of the ballet-on-ice program — obedient, disciplined, and desperate to land the lead role of the Black Swan in the Winter Showcase. There's just one problem: she has no idea how to be "bad." Enter Tristan Beaumont, the university's most notorious playboy and captain of the hockey team — reckless, magnetic, and hiding a devastating secret behind his bad-boy reputation. When Abby asks him to teach her how to unleash her dark side, neither of them expects what happens next: a forbidden attraction neither can control. Standing between them is Taylor Beaumont, Tristan's younger brother — Abby's skating partner, her best friend, and the "good" Beaumont everyone expects her to choose. As rumors, sabotage, and a jealous rival threaten to destroy everything Abby has worked for, she must decide who she really wants — and who she's willing to fight for. Torn between two brothers, a forbidden romance, and the role of a lifetime, Abby will learn that becoming the Black Swan means learning to stop following the rules — and start listening to her heart.
6a686012cd3a8257390f38c9.title: Offside with the Hockey Star

6a6964532c99fcb36e0f17bb.synopsis: The heir of a wealthy family, Lucas, voluntarily went to prison to overthrow his half brother. His fiancée abandoned him and went to live with his half brother. After being released from prison, he concealed his wealthy identity and entered into a contractual marriage with the orphaned girl, Ava. Gradually, true feelings developed between them. Ava discovered that she was the long-lost heiress of a rich family. When her old enemies came after her, Lucas revealed his true identity and embarked on a desperate revenge to help her.
6a6964532c99fcb36e0f17bb.title: The Double Life of My Ex-Con Husband

6a69928e1c117e13980f9f41.synopsis: After three years of fighting on the northern front, legendary dragon rider Kalen Gerard returns home, ready to marry the woman he has loved for years. Instead, he finds his castle occupied, his fiancée pregnant with another man's child, and his family legacy stolen by a shameless usurper. Branded a worthless nobody, Kalen is ordered to give up his title, his home, and even raise his fiancée's illegitimate child. But no one knows the truth—he is the kingdom's greatest war hero, the man who slew the Black Dragon and saved humanity.
6a69928e1c117e13980f9f41.title: The Betrayed Demi-God Reclaims Everything

6a69994f1ed5911c3f03759d.synopsis: Bankrupt heiress Isolde signs a three-year mistress contract with Savien Thorne, heir to the Thorn Group, just to cover her mother’s life-saving medical bills. The second the contract ends, she’s ready to walk away for good. Until she finds out she’s pregnant. His arranged fiancée learns the secret, and torments her at every turn. Worse — she’s never been anything but a double for the other woman. She moves out and cuts all ties. But he’s not letting her get away.
6a69994f1ed5911c3f03759d.title: His Caged Love

6a699eaa437c05bf2f08576c.synopsis: Ethan Cole, a top-tier aviation legend in his previous life, dies as a national aviation legend. He is reborn as an 8-year-old boy on the same flight where he once flew with his father. Only this time, he knows the truth: Flight 8236 is going to crash, and everyone on board will die. At 9,000 meters above sea level, fire begins to burn along the wings. The fuselage cracks open into freezing air. As panic spreads across the cabin, Ethan realizes he is the only one who understands what is coming. Trapped in a child’s body, he must stop the disaster and save his father—the man he loves most—before it is too late.
6a699eaa437c05bf2f08576c.title: The Eight-Year-Old Captain

6a69d75694d45d05cf089596.synopsis: A gifted contract mage, Layla, spent her past life collecting ninety-nine sacred cores to help her contracted beast, the Sacred Whale Neil, take human form—only to have Neil pierce her heart and push her into the Bloodtide Trench the moment he transformed. Reborn on the day of the contract ceremony, Layla abandons the Sacred Whale and chooses a dying little spirit snake instead. Neil, now in human form, teams up with her sister Evelyn to humiliate her, but the little snake turns out to be Poseidon, the Sea Emperor. As past betrayals and old wounds resurface, Neil kneels in regret—too late. Only Poseidon stands by her side. This time, Layla will never waste herself on the unworthy again, and finally learns to live for herself.
6a69d75694d45d05cf089596.title: After the Sacred Whale Betrayed Me, I Contracted Poseidon

6a6ab69baaeb8126f103b73a.synopsis: To discover who truly loves them, wealthy couple Hannah and her husband fake bankruptcy, with him pretending to be paralyzed after a stroke. Their test exposes the truth: their biological son Thomas and his wife refuse to help and turn them away, while adopted son Theo and his wife give up everything to save him. After learning the truth, Hannah and her husband leave their $50 million fortune to Theo. Thomas loses everything and finally realizes that true family is built on love, not blood.
6a6ab69baaeb8126f103b73a.title: The Billionaire Parents' Final Test

6a6afb1f12895345d90f1e50.synopsis: No mate, no wolf, and raising a pup alone, Ella never expected one act of kindness to tie her fate to Alpha Torin, who is cursed to never touch a woman. When she becomes the wet nurse to his newborn heir, Ella is pulled into a deadly game of jealousy and betrayal inside the Alpha's keep.
6a6afb1f12895345d90f1e50.title: Thirsty for the Wet Nurse

6a6b2207a6fa584bc0046f6e.synopsis: After surviving a month of kidnapping and torture, Claire returns home with severe PTSD, only to be misunderstood and humiliated by her brother Maxwell and her family. As her trauma becomes impossible to ignore, Maxwell begins to doubt his judgment — but when Claire gives up on ten years of love and walks away, he finally realizes the truth was never what he believed.
6a6b2207a6fa584bc0046f6e.title: Once Love Is Lost, It Never Returns

6a6c022eedfbef3f380fbfbf.synopsis: I lied about my age and ghosted my clingy online boyfriend half a year ago. Staying at my best friend’s house for break, I froze—her cold, CEO older brother Rhys was exactly the man I dumped online. He recognized me just by my voice and kept testing me nonstop. Later at a bar, he chugged eight drinks to shield me from a creep guy who drugged me. Trapped in his car, he recited every fake detail I told him online, staring at me: “Did you ever regret leaving me?”
6a6c022eedfbef3f380fbfbf.title: The Cold CEO Who Spoiled Me Online

6a6ff71e2cf525542e0730f1.synopsis: Head over heels for Preston, the Principal's son, Mia has always put him first. But when she finds out he's been cheating on her with the rich heiress Vivian Walden, Mia hatches a grand escape plan with Preston's opportunistic mother. Will Preston capture her heart back before it leaves permanently for London, or will Sebastian, the mysterious royal boy from London get Mia's love?
6a6ff71e2cf525542e0730f1.title: My Royal Rebound

6a700666eef7d6f5550a0b27.synopsis: In I’m Pregnant It’s Not Yours movie, husband prefers secretary, who looks like his white moonlight, over his wife Iris. Calmly, Iris asks for a divorce, revealing that the baby she's carrying isn't his. Five years later, she returns powerfully with her new flame, while Husband is left drowning in regret.
6a700666eef7d6f5550a0b27.title: I’m Pregnant, It’s Not Yours

6a70084e74a2229b72018fb6.synopsis: For ten years, janitor Maya scrimps and saves while raising her daughter Lily almost entirely on her own—only to discover that her husband, Adrian, is actually a multimillionaire who has lavished all his love and affection on his first love and her son. Completely heartbroken, Maya leaves with Lily. She is later revealed to be the daughter of a fallen war hero, and after reclaiming her true identity, she becomes the long-lost beloved heiress of the powerful Harrington family. When Adrian loses his business, his family, and the wife and daughter he took for granted, he falls to his knees and begs for forgiveness. Lily gives him only one final answer: “Daddy, we’re done.”
6a70084e74a2229b72018fb6.title: Daddy We're Done

6a702ff9bfebe859c8010184.synopsis: Olivia, an art student harboring a secret crush on a star hockey player, accidentally stumbles upon the shocking truth: Liam, the campus playboy, is secretly an anonymous adult content creator. To keep his secret safe, the two enter into a dangerous "fake dating" pact. As they navigate endless teasing, power struggles, and joint battles against campus bullying and malicious schemes, their pretend romance begins to blur into real passion. However, just as they finally face their true feelings for each other, a deadly blackmail scheme threatens to destroy everything Liam holds dear...
6a702ff9bfebe859c8010184.title: Puck Perfect: My Sex Education Tutor

6a70478c9dbba6268204e160.synopsis: Vince buried his past with Dante, the mob heir who vanished five years ago. When Dante returns, he's still reckless, still devastating, still determined to win Vince back. But Leo, the fragile younger brother Vince saved, wants him too. Caught between two brothers, Vince must decide if the man who broke him once is worth the risk again.
6a70478c9dbba6268204e160.title: Forbidden Night with the Mafia Heir

6a70478f9dbba6268204e166.synopsis: Willow celebrates a positive pregnancy test until she overhears a monstrous truth: her Alpha husband, Adrian, has never touched her. Every time she trusted him, his Beta took his place behind her blindfold, while Adrian built a lie to brand her unfaithful and crown his mistress Luna. Betrayed, pregnant, and trapped in a pack that calls her wolfless and ugly, Willow plans her escape. But under the full moon, her birthmark vanishes, a legendary white wolf awakens, and the men who used her begin hunting the woman they can no longer recognize.
6a70478f9dbba6268204e166.title: The Alpha Lost His Ugly Luna

6a7143c1abc1c458e804435b.synopsis: Amber Ryder, a rugged horse breeder, is forced to sell her most dangerous stallion to billionaire polo heir, Henry Harding to keep her father's ranch afloat. Amber doubts if Henry has the grit to tame this wild stallion, but as they train the difficult horse, they realize the real fight isn't the horse... it's each other. Will these two horse-lovers rein in their desires… or let the flames of passion burn brighter?
6a7143c1abc1c458e804435b.title: Reins of Desire

6a7148b271f37e5a1d0e518d.synopsis: Kaelen Ashfell bought me at the Mate Auction for a fortune. Three years later, after I gave him three hatchlings, his first love came back, and he crossed my name out of his Bond Ledger like I was property to return. He handed me and our babies to his brother Roran, then let his first love tear apart my den, my garden, and even hurt our child. Kael thought regret could bring me back. But the mate he discarded was about to learn what it felt like to be protected by someone else.
6a7148b271f37e5a1d0e518d.title: The Auctioned Mate

6a718008e9f96f29f507ec5f.synopsis: In The Atlantic Bride movie, in 1911, amid New York’s Gilded Age, Evelyn Hart, a rural English schoolteacher, voyages across the ocean for love, only to suffer betrayal at the hands of her fiancé Thomas. On the ocean liner, she comes to the rescue of Julian Kane, a mysterious wounded man, and agrees to a marriage of convenience with him when left with nowhere to turn. Little does she know he is the heir to the Kane family empire, commanding railways, shipping and steel. What begins as a reclusive tycoon hiding his true identity blossoms into a tender romance. As workplace clashes and taunts from her old rival mount, affection grows between them, while the truth of his identity slowly surfaces amid the unfolding drama.
6a718008e9f96f29f507ec5f.title: The Atlantic Bride

6a71aad3d35a1776dd0e357d.synopsis: When James loses his daughter Amy and his legs on the same day, he stops believing in magic. Little does he know, Amy is now Mia, a fortune-telling prodigy come to save James from his fatal bad karma.
6a71aad3d35a1776dd0e357d.title: Little Miss Fortune

6a7295ece52ae6cfe901ca85.synopsis: Sawyer is a quarterback prodigy, but his mom Marnie always ignores him in favor of his adopted brother, Ben, even when Ben frames Sawyer, steals his MVP title, and ruins his future. Heartbroken, Sawyer vows to make his mom realize just how much she hurt him and how much she's lost.
6a7295ece52ae6cfe901ca85.title: The Son Rises Alone

6a7296b9d0e875c4150ea9e9.synopsis: After claiming her fifth World Culinary Championship, the legendary Chef Sage goes undercover as a homeless beggar to find a partner with genuine character. Ignored by the masses and ruthlessly mocked by her ex, she encounters Jasper, a kind-hearted man who offers her his food. Desperate to save his family's failing restaurant from a vicious corporate takeover, Jasper hires Sage to play his wealthy fake fiancée. As rival factions push the Vance family to the brink with a high-stakes "Culinary Death Match," all hope seems lost. But when cornered, the beggar bride sheds her disguise. With a flash of her blade and her signature blue flame, she turns the tables against world-class chefs, exposing her true identity and sparking a legendary romance.
6a7296b9d0e875c4150ea9e9.title: My Homeless Bride Is a Culinary Legend

6a72d8a9a4caeefb6102148b.synopsis: Caleb Shaw calls BDSM a cure for his dead marriage, then chains his wife Mara to a tree for his mistress. When Mara says the safe word, he leaves with the key. By sunrise, Nina’s hired men find her. But Caleb never knew what Mara buried for this marriage. She was not just his wife. She was the woman who once owned the West Side docks. Now the collar, the blood, and the betrayal will drag every Shaw secret into the light.
6a72d8a9a4caeefb6102148b.title: My Safe Word Was Revenge

6a72d8b2f2d34be5d20118cb.synopsis: Samantha Hughes waited a whole year for AURA’s final farewell concert, only to find her childhood sweetheart Logan kissing Sierra outside the venue after giving away Sam’s VIP ticket. When Logan keeps choosing Sierra, exposes Sam’s family trauma, and later abandons her during a fire, Sam finally sees the boy she loved is gone. She withdraws from Berkeley, moves to New York, rebuilds her life with her mother, and refuses every attempt Logan makes to drag her back. Even when Sierra tries to ruin her reputation and Logan begs for another chance, Sam chooses peace, dignity, and a new love who actually stays.
6a72d8b2f2d34be5d20118cb.title: Scorched Heart

6a72f122a2ed0db5070b250d.synopsis: In Abandoned Pawn Unrivaled Dragon King movie, Owen — discarded heir of the Hull family, the one and only disciple of the master of the Dragon Knight Sanctum. He awakens the Ten Dragon God Marks and forges a soul-deep bond with Akura, bearer of the ancient Golden Dragon bloodline. Betrayed by his own family, stripped of his name, and tormented by the very Sanctum that should have been his home — when the buried truth finally breaks free, the outcast of old rises in the full wrath of a Dragon God and grinds every last humiliation to dust. From that moment on, the young dragonlord sets forth across the land with his dragon at his side, and the entire continent shudders as the sky itself begins to change.
6a72f122a2ed0db5070b250d.title: Abandoned Pawn, Unrivaled Dragon King

6a732af43810ec89a30584cf.synopsis: Five years ago, Elena Hartwell broke up with her college boyfriend Killian Thorne to protect him from her ruthless uncle Victor—making him believe she was a gold-digger. Heartbroken, Killian returned to his family's trillion-dollar empire, while Elena was framed by Victor and imprisoned, where she gave birth to their daughter Luna. Now, brave 4-year-old Luna tracks down Killian at his corporate headquarters, shocking everyone by calling him "Daddy." After a DNA test confirms the truth, Killian learns of Elena's wrongful conviction and the sacrifices she made. With his power and resources, he sets out to free Elena, protect Luna from Victor's schemes, and win back the woman he never stopped loving.
6a732af43810ec89a30584cf.title: Mommy's Little Savior

6a737ed7c18545ffc201ea79.synopsis: In Bound by the Past movie, 8 years after Dante took a bullet for Valentina, a mafia war rages between Chicago and Las Vegas. With a world of bloodshed knocking on their door, they must decide how to protect their daughter, and their marriage.
6a737ed7c18545ffc201ea79.title: Bound by the Past

6a73e8221ba18f8dcb0e84b9.synopsis: After a devastating betrayal that decimates two powerful wolf packs, young Nora Reed is forced into a mating bond with Alpha Drake, her enemy, her savior, and the man who believes she's responsible for his family's death. For three years, Drake torments her, determined never to love her. But when he finally claims her body and then shoves her aside, Nora shatters. She cuts their magical soul-bond and disappears. Years later, she returns not as Nora Reed, but as Nadia Moon, heiress to a royal European pack, cloaked in wealth, power. Her mission is clear, protect her children, reclaim her power, and avoid Drake at all costs.
6a73e8221ba18f8dcb0e84b9.title: Crowned in Silver Blood

6a7456d6a4740b6805050945.synopsis: Elite doc Christine catches mafia boss Damon's eye—her eggs are top-tier, and he wants his heir. She hates his guts: same mob that drove her mom to suicide. She rushes a wedding to escape, but Damon crashes the ceremony and snatches her. Locked in his penthouse, he comes at her hard every night; she fights back twice as hard. But slowly she sees past the ice—when someone drugs her, Damon burns it all down to save her. That twisted, obsessed devotion cracks her open. Christine drops the grudge. They end up together, damaged but locked in.
6a7456d6a4740b6805050945.title: The Mob Boss Demands Her Perfect Genes

6a754311338f32d80c0fc293.synopsis: Wealthy heiress Emily is hunted down by her relatives over her massive inheritance. She flees to her family’s rural farm for shelter, only to accidentally discover that their fireplace connects to a dragon‑ruled otherworld. She keeps sending modern supplies to this realm, aiding Kael, the metal dragon lord, in protecting his people and homeland. To the dragons, she becomes the "Dragon God". From firewood and medicine to modern weaponry, she reshapes the dragon‑race war step by step — and rewrites her own destiny.
6a754311338f32d80c0fc293.title: My Fireplace Ships to Dragon Realm

6a759aa8a6c28014960e4808.synopsis: On a snowy Thanksgiving, young healer Rita lives with her ungrateful uncle William and his cruel family. They exploit her powers, sabotage her feast, and secretly hire a thug to drive her away. Hunted and alone, she is rescued by mafia godfather Richard Genovese and his wife. Discovering their kindness and lack of an heir, they adopt her. On the journey, Rita's powers save them from crises, alarming Richard's rival. At the manor, she heals Richard's dying father, Arthur, and finds a lost heirloom. Her courage and abilities win the family's trust. Rita becomes a true Genovese, protecting her new family with everything she has.
6a759aa8a6c28014960e4808.title: The Godfather's Guardian Angel

6a75a8e09314bb5f390efc2d.synopsis: When Naomi accidentally summons Thanatos, the God of Death, a desperate kiss awakens his heart after ten thousand years. Revealed as his destined Bride of Death, Naomi is the only one who can break his curse, while the immortal reaper discovers that even a god can fall in love.
6a75a8e09314bb5f390efc2d.title: My Marriage with the God of Death

6a7619d41dcbbd8e12015bfe.synopsis: In Altarboy movie, after getting kicked out for being gay, 18-year-old Theo is dumped at a Catholic church to be "cured" — and finds his new priest is young, hot... and a huge jerk who makes Theo his personal altar boy. What starts as a game of temptation becomes a slow-burn obsession neither can pray away, but as the game turns real, both Theo and Alexander risk losing everything to a love neither of them is supposed to want.
6a7619d41dcbbd8e12015bfe.title: Altarboy

6a792e03ee704ba9f605ffb9.synopsis: In My Billionaire Boss Won't Let Me Quit movie, seeking a fresh start after years of managing crises, Grace takes on a new job, only to be swept into a fake marriage by her enigmatic boss, Mason. As their pretend arrangement blurs into undeniable passion, Grace falls deeper into his spell. But Mason is playing a far more dangerous game—and he has no intention of ever letting her go.
6a792e03ee704ba9f605ffb9.title: My Billionaire Boss Won't Let Me Quit

6a792e8f6760fac43a08230d.synopsis: Everyone accuses Faye of being a gold-digging prostitute because of her hobo clothes. Little do they realize that she's the ONLY ONE who can cure the hottest and richest man in the nation - war hero, Adam Stone! (And win his heart too)
6a792e8f6760fac43a08230d.title: The Hobo Goddess and Her Billion-Dollar Contract

6a792f892dee9a176102157c.synopsis: In Shattered Vows movie, princess Venessa lived a sheltered life—until her sister was murdered. Stripped of her innocence in a single night, she must confront a devastating betrayal: her husband and best friend just helped the killer escape justice. The pampered princess is gone. Now she's coming for every last one of them, to take back the justice they owe her sister.
6a792f892dee9a176102157c.title: Loved Me Most, Betrayed Me Worst

6a79353639273200140302fe.synopsis: Vivienne and Adrian are moments away from adopting a sweet little girl when Vivienne notices a pea-sized birthmark on the child's hand. She immediately refuses to sign and demands a divorce. Adrian kneels. His family calls her cruel, barren, and heartless. Even the child begs her not to leave. No one understands why Vivienne would destroy a loving marriage over such a tiny mark, and she refuses to explain. Not until Vivienne unveils three reports at a live press conference does the truth behind that tiny birthmark finally begin to surface.
6a79353639273200140302fe.title: A Birthmark Exposed My Husband’s Secret

6a79353ca5472245d60215b3.synopsis: I’m Seraphina, ocean princess. In my last life, I loved shark lord Kael, yet he held me down while his lover Lira stabbed my heart with venom crystal. Reborn on my mate-picking day, I shocked everyone by choosing Rhys, the playful dragon eel playboy. Kael seethed, ignored me when assassins poisoned me, and knelt begging me to ditch Rhys later. But Lira’s fake fragility hides deadly malice—she just pushed me into deadly undertow. Can Rhys reach me before I drown?
6a79353ca5472245d60215b3.title: I Chose The Playboy Eel To Abandon My Shark Lover

6a79353f9620ad2c7704348f.synopsis: For three years, Elena endured a marriage where every affair ended the same way—her husband handed her another man as compensation. When his pregnant mistress demanded a wedding, he expected another fake divorce and another obedient return. Instead, Elena accepted the young man he chose, signed the papers, and walked away for good. By the time Damian uncovered the truth behind the betrayal that destroyed their marriage, she was already standing at another altar. This time, the bride never looked back.
6a79353f9620ad2c7704348f.title: My Husband Gifted Me His Rival

6a799b227ca81994420fb772.synopsis: Victoria, the secret head of a powerful aristocratic family, rejects an arranged marriage for her longtime boyfriend, Julian. On her way to see him, she saves billionaire CEO Alexander Blackwood from an accident, unknowingly awakening his wolf-spirit mark that identifies her as his destined mate. Victoria rejects Alexander's sudden proposal and heads to Julian's promotion party—a position she secretly secured for him. However, Julian publicly humiliates her, offering her a buyout check so he can marry Chloe, the daughter of a Blackwood executive, to secure his status. When Victoria reveals she is the true mastermind behind his success, Julian and the elite guests mock her as a delusional beggar. Just as security corners Victoria to throw her out, Alexander violently crashes the party...
6a799b227ca81994420fb772.title: The Destined One

6a79a5ea47342654bf008f37.synopsis: Trash dog’s epic counterattack! Inheriting Anubis’s legacy, he evolves by devouring everything! Tortures villains, protects his master, fights the world-destroying serpent, and finally breaks through to SSS rank as Anubis, becoming a god in one battle!
6a79a5ea47342654bf008f37.title: Devour to the God of Death from a Stray Dog

6a7a194a6381c9b8fc06a1d9.synopsis: Cain Hunter, heir to the almighty Godfather, is back! He'll fight past mind-controlling schemers and threats haunting the shadows, whatever it takes to pass the ten trials his grandfather has set for him. But what if it all comes at a cost? What if it means losing the love of his life, Annalise?
6a7a194a6381c9b8fc06a1d9.title: Super Godfather 2: My Ex Dumped the Wrong Man

6a7a81a517f42fe9c400a799.synopsis: Five years ago, Tiffany was betrayed by her fiancé and best friend, poisoned, and left for dead while pregnant. She survived, but her newborn daughter vanished without a trace. Desperate to find her, Tiffany takes a job as a nanny at the Silvermoon Pack, never realizing the little princess in her care is her own missing daughter. The girl's father is Asher Sterling—the ruthless, untouchable Alpha who has spent five years searching for the mysterious woman from his one unforgettable night. As Tiffany and Asher are drawn together, old enemies resurface, deadly secrets unravel...
6a7a81a517f42fe9c400a799.title: The Alpha and His Nanny Luna

6a7a81d232f8351021093876.synopsis: Two years ago, a car accident left me blind. My sense of sight finally returned to me one day... and the very first thing I saw... was my wife cheating on me.
6a7a81d232f8351021093876.title: Blind No Longer: My Wife's Betrayal

6a7ade3bcccb5af57d0f0ddc.synopsis: Lord Julian Thornfield burns Adeline’s village, turns her into a vampire, and forces her to become his dead wife’s replacement. Even his daughter, Eve, calls her “Mama.” When Adeline tries to die, Eve’s strange power hurls them a hundred years into the past. There, Julian is not a cruel lord yet. He is a scarred human slave in a circus cage, whipped as a monster. Adeline only wants to hand Eve back and escape, but the child’s broken heart ties her to them both. Then the caged man asks who she is, and Adeline answers, “I’m your future wife.”
6a7ade3bcccb5af57d0f0ddc.title: I Was My Vampire Husband's Dead Wife

6a7ade45f3da91a7740b6032.synopsis: Once a straight A freshman, Emma Lucas lost everything when Adrian Cole filmed her in bed and let her nudes spread across campus. He said her brother owed his sister a life, then made Emma pay for it. Three years later, Emma strips to keep Ryan alive, only to find Adrian in the VIP booth, paying men to humiliate her. “How did you get this cheap?” But when her family shatters and the truth about Lily resurfaces, Adrian’s revenge starts looking like the cruelest mistake of his life.
6a7ade45f3da91a7740b6032.title: My First Love Pays to Watch Me Strip

6a7ade4b6dd79807440adcb9.synopsis: Born with the sealed bloodline of Hades, Lia Thorne is raised as the lost daughter of the wealthy Lancaster family. But when her return exposes their crimes and shatters their "lucky" adopted daughter Ava's perfect life, Lia is branded a curse. On her twelfth birthday, her parents drug her and leave her at Black Rose Manor, the most feared mafia estate in Black Bay. They expect her to die. Instead, mafia queen Veronica Knight and executioner Damian Wolf protect her as their little princess. As enemies close in, Lia's hidden power awakens, turning every betrayal into deadly karma.
6a7ade4b6dd79807440adcb9.title: Hades' Mafia Princess

6a7ae421b439ccf70a081b47.synopsis: Betrayed by her boyfriend. Hunted down by her father. Forced to mate with a ruthless Alpha King. Cora thought her life was over until she escaped and accidentally marked a dangerous, magnetic stranger. Left with no choice, she accepted a fake mating proposal from that stranger, totally unaware that her "contract mate" is the very Alpha King she’s desperately trying to escape...
6a7ae421b439ccf70a081b47.title: Caught! The Ruthless Alpha's Runaway Luna

6a7bd0ea617617b70101f8ba.synopsis: In The Rockstar's Secret movie, Juniper is hopelessly, recklessly in love with Tristan—the dark, intoxicating rockstar who rules their campus. The catch? He’s her protective older brother Carter’s best friend, and as far as Tristan is concerned, Juniper is nothing more than an invisible little sister. Until the night the lights go out. Trapped in the pitch-black darkness, a wild, uninhibited flame ignites between them—a night of unforgettable passion with a mysterious girl whose face Tristan never saw. All he has to trace his secret lover is a delicate butterfly bracelet left behind, and the vivid memory of a butterfly birthmark. He is obsessively hunting for the stranger who shattered his world, unaware that the girl he craves is sitting right across his kitchen table. But if Tristan discovers Juniper was the woman in the dark, and if Carter finds out his best friend touched his sister, the fallout could destroy them all. Can a love born in the shadows survive the brutal light of truth?
6a7bd0ea617617b70101f8ba.title: The Rockstar's Secret

6a7c48e5b4c56e59bc06ed9a.synopsis: Elena is drugged by her stepfather and, at a masked ball, has a night with Vincent—a powerful heir who can't touch any woman due to childhood trauma. She gives birth to Leo, but Frank sends the baby to an orphanage. Vincent recognizes his tie at the scene, adopts Leo, and brings him home. Desperate to reclaim her child, Elena applies as a wet nurse at Cunningham Manor, reuniting with Vincent—neither recognizes the other. Leo only drinks Elena's milk. Vincent discovers Elena is the only woman he can touch without repulsion, and gradually falls for her. Frank's schemes and Lina's sabotage are repeatedly thwarted by Vincent. Elena learns her child has been "adopted" by the Clintons, but discovers the child isn't hers—the orphanage director was deceiving her. Vincent produces the tie: Leo is her son, and Vincent is the masked man from that night. Vincent confronts his father Charles, exposing the abuse that drove his mother to suicide. Charles concedes, accepting Elena. The family of three reunites in a grand wedding.
6a7c48e5b4c56e59bc06ed9a.title: Mafia's Desire for the Wet Nurse

6a7d21ead4f206c4400f1499.synopsis: Based on the novel by bestselling author Cora Reilly. 21 year old Giulia Rizzo suddenly finds herself engaged to the ruthless crimelord Cassio Moretti against her will. Rumor has it he's responsible for the bloody, untimely death of his wife, whom Giulia is not only replacing as a wife, but as the mother of their two young children. Will rebellious Giulia manage to make a life for herself alongside Cassio, or will his refusal to let her into his heart create yet another broken marriage?
6a7d21ead4f206c4400f1499.title: Sweet Temptation

6a7d2695c110da6695071109.synopsis: Kaelen, a fallen noble, is betrayed by his beloved and exiled by humanity—only to awaken the Abyssal Demon Lord's supreme bloodline in the lightless abyss. He rises with a cursed serpent-woman by his side, vowing to tear down the hypocritical gods and divide the sun among all races. In this world, light is a weapon of the powerful. Human nobles drain their own kind's blood to fuel "divine sanction" and oppress dissenters. The demons and beast tribes are the true victims—starved of sunlight and hunted. The protagonist's struggle is a war against class oppression. When the magic altar is destroyed, an energy tsunami shatters the barrier confining the beast tribes. Tens of thousands of starving warriors surge into human territory—igniting a colossal war that engulfs humans, demons, beasts, and gods. Kaelen must unite enemies, break the gods' monopoly on light, and reshape the world.
6a7d2695c110da6695071109.title: Abyssal Throne：The Godslayer

6a7d31e470be7cd955059ad9.synopsis: In 1849, the American West, poor dockworker William is betrayed by his lover and his boss, losing everything and becoming a slave laborer in a gold mine. On the brink of death, he awakens a mysterious "Golden Eye" that allows him to see through anything and uncover hidden treasures. From a powerless nobody to a legendary mining tycoon, William uses his extraordinary vision and intelligence to defeat the elites who once crushed him!
6a7d31e470be7cd955059ad9.title: King of Gold

6a7d37d954d2787d000968cc.synopsis: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by mutant beasts, Kane is humanity's one and only War God — yet he hides his identity, secretly gifting seventeen top military honors to his girlfriend Sena. On her promotion day, she coldly dumps him as a "worthless nobody soldier." Meanwhile, City Lord Eve, forced into a political marriage by the corrupt government, proposes a fake marriage to Kane — never suspecting who he truly is. As elites humiliate him and scheme against her, the War God finally rises. Revenge, romance, and absolute power collide.
6a7d37d954d2787d000968cc.title: Wasteland Sovereign

6a7daee9a884ec41830ad386.synopsis: "You're lying." That's what my husband said when I begged him to save me. Six months pregnant, I was kidnapped, beaten, and left to lose our baby—while he chose his mistress over me again and again. So I gave him exactly what he deserved: my death. Now he thinks he buried his wife and daughter. But I'm still alive... and this time, I'll bury everything he loves.
6a7daee9a884ec41830ad386.title: I Faked My Death To Ruin My Mafia Husband

6a7e8d88d2bd828b3d09c462.synopsis: On her first day at Maple Elite Academy, transfer student Emma Parker does the unthinkable — she picks a fight with The Big Four, the untouchable heirs who rule the school. Tyrannical Rowan Calloway wants to break her. Golden-boy August Langford wants to protect her. But behind their masks, nothing is what it seems. The closer they get, the harder they fall — for the girl who was never meant to belong in their world. Enemies… or childhood friends? When it comes to Rowan and August, the answer is never simple. Who will she choose?
6a7e8d88d2bd828b3d09c462.title: Taming My Bullies 1-3

6a826d6cfbecc43db80d69ac.synopsis: Straight-A bookworm Georgia Pruitt accidentally shoves rockstar Riot Cross off his stage, so her strict father ships her to Silver Pines reform camp, where Riot's label sends him too. Bound as accountability buddies, the enemies fall in love through bullying storms, lakeside rescues, a stolen kiss, and a rewritten love song. When leaked photos force a breakup, Riot leaps from his departing car to sing with her onstage, and they choose each other and music school over Harvard and the tour.
6a826d6cfbecc43db80d69ac.title: Summer with a Superstar

6a826e8e44e10020b10b8cae.synopsis: A destitute orphan Layla accidentally stumbles into the Wolf King Kai's suite, and one night soul-binds them. He throws a check at her. She rips it up and slaps him. A month later, Layla discovers she's pregnant with sextuplets. Her greedy stepfamily sells her for $100,000. Kai transforms into a silver wolf, rescues her, and declares her his destined mate. Layla joins K-Group on her own merit. Kai secretly courts her. But Kai's rumored fiancée Chloe humiliates Layla—until Kai breaks the engagement publicly. Chloe colludes with a dark warlock to sell Layla, revealing she's a sacred vessel to break the wolf clan's curse. Kai rescues her and exposes Chloe as an identity thief. Layla is the true Grey heiress, swapped at birth. Layla delivers sextuplets, ending the curse. From abandoned orphan to matriarch of two clans, she rises to become beloved by all.
6a826e8e44e10020b10b8cae.title: A Cinderella for Wolf King

6a827a32afda3505f70a3fd5.synopsis: My cold, ruthless Mafia godfather guardian tore off his mask the night of my twenty-first birthday. He doesn't want me to call him uncle anymore. He wants me as his caged bird.
6a827a32afda3505f70a3fd5.title: Locked by the Mafia Boss

6a829ec71040adbe930df3f0.synopsis: I called 911 because I accidentally handcuffed myself to my bed. I expected a locksmith. Instead, my ex-boyfriend kicked down my door—with three firefighters behind him. He thinks another man tied me up and abandoned me. Then I blurt out, "No, I didn't use protection." Now he's furious, jealous, and refusing to believe the truth. My biggest embarrassment just became his biggest misunderstanding... and neither of us is ready for what comes next.
6a829ec71040adbe930df3f0.title: My Hot Firefighter Ex

6a82a37cff4c44e98402a664.synopsis: On the Dragon Continent, bloodline is everything. Pure dragon blood grants shifting forms and magic resistance. Those who can't shift are called Exiles — treated as slaves. Kaelen, firstborn of the Red Dragon House, was born unable to shift. On the eve of his coming-of-age, his three brothers cut his tendons, stripped his inheritance, and took his fiancée. His father branded him a slave and exiled him to the Silent Deadfire Volcano. In the volcano's depths, disaster became blessing. The dragon blood within him awakened the ancient Progenitor Dragon God's inheritance. Over ten years, his severed bones regenerated, and he mastered world-destroying Dragon Tongue magic. Ten years later, holy war breaks out. The Red Dragon House faces extinction. Kaelen returns as a cold dragon hunter—identity hidden. One crisis after another forces his enemies to kneel. His former fiancée regrets everything. In the end, before the entire continent, he reveals his true form: the Progenitor Dragon, reclaiming his throne.
6a82a37cff4c44e98402a664.title: The Dragon's Return: Reclaiming My Throne

6a82a75faf43836c55050f31.synopsis: After World War III, I became a scavenger in a chaotic world, surviving by trading salvaged junk for supplies—while being bullied by classmates who would steal what I'd gathered. By chance, I discovered alien technology and rescued three beautiful women who became my wives. Now, I aim to use these assets to become the King of the Wasteland!
6a82a75faf43836c55050f31.title: I Rule the Wasteland Harem

6a82ad6dc5c23b33ea076aa7.synopsis: Klare is an overlooked nurse at Venus Hospital, struggling with severe anxiety after a family tragedy. Her only comfort is submitting online to a mysterious “Master,” whose commands make her feel safe. But in real life, her new boss, Dance Gordon, is arrogant, sharp-tongued, and always targeting her. By day, they clash at the hospital. By night, he is the perfect Master behind the screen, giving all his patience and tenderness to his one and only — “Cake.” Enemies in real life. Addicted online.
6a82ad6dc5c23b33ea076aa7.title: My Boss Is My Secret Online Dom

6a82dec8118665dc400e9516.synopsis: Agent Zoe is betrayed by her fiancé and stepsister during a zombie apocalypse, but is unexpectedly saved by the zombie king Ethan on the brink of death. To complete a secret mission, she approaches Ethan to uncover the truth behind the virus, only to discover their fated connection. From using each other to falling deeply in love, they join forces to seek revenge, expose the conspiracy, and end the apocalypse.
6a82dec8118665dc400e9516.title: Date with the Zombie King

6a82e0b7e9eb6dc4dc02e08f.synopsis: On her wedding day, Jagger Hamilton abandons Avery for his adopted sister Tatum. Jagger's uncle Beckett, Manhattan's feared "Ice Blade," marries her instead. Three years later, Avery carries Beckett's long-awaited child, but Jagger and Tatum return and brutally kill the baby. Beckett exacts brutal revenge, crippling and disowning them. Years later, Avery and Beckett welcome a healthy son, while a ruined, disabled Jagger—rejected by the family—takes his own life.
6a82e0b7e9eb6dc4dc02e08f.title: I Married the Groom's Uncle

6a83582174c9804c810424cc.synopsis: In Salt Kiss movie, ex-soldier Tristan becomes bodyguard to his uncle-in-law, a magnetic billionaire who runs an exclusive sex club. Despite his best efforts to stay professional, Tristan's drawn to his boss’s dominance, breaking down his defenses until he finally submits. Under Mark’s seduction, Tristan is pulled into a world of pain and pleasure he never imagined. But his lust for Mark unravels when he’s sent to retrieve Mark’s fiancée… and falls for her too.
6a83582174c9804c810424cc.title: Salt Kiss

6a83592a759e4ec057062e6a.synopsis: In Honey Cut movie, when her father forces her to marry billionaire Mark Trevena, good Catholic girl Isolde expects a monster. Instead she finds herself falling for two men — her dangerous new husband and his fiercely loyal bodyguard Tristan. As jealousy, betrayal and forbidden desire push all three to their breaking point, they must choose between destroying each other... or risking everything to stay as one.
6a83592a759e4ec057062e6a.title: Honey Cut

6a8379be6731ef37180e9dba.synopsis: After their fellow veteran's apparent death, hard-bitten Nick Gallo and two other brothers-in-arms join forces in Las Vegas to protect the man’s wife and daughter from a savage local mob. Nick starts falling in love with the family, but his relationship is thrown into chaos after a shocking return.
6a8379be6731ef37180e9dba.title: Brothers in Arms

6a838595487d2558ff0a648a.synopsis: In I Don't Need No Alpha Brothers movie, when Elara was a child, she saved Alpha Mason’s life. Out of gratitude, he took her in as his adopted daughter and brought her back to the Stormfang Pack. Mason promised that when Elara turned eighteen, she would choose one of his five sons—Ethan, Frank, Gabriel, Henry, or Ian—to marry. The six of them grew up together, inseparable, shaped by years of shared memories. Everything changed when Jenny appeared. Manipulated by her lies, the five men repeatedly hurt Elara, slowly breaking her heart. Hurt and betrayed, Elara resolves to cut ties.
6a838595487d2558ff0a648a.title: I Don't Need No Alpha Brothers

6a8387a6232923bdbe0d2b5b.synopsis: Based on novel by Sierra Simone... When Isolde Laurence is pressured by her father to kill her own husband, Mark Trevena, she chooses to protect him instead. But when Mark overhears her father's orders, he believes she still intends to murder him. A misunderstanding destroys a whirlwind romance as Mark, a BDSM dom, puts Isolde through a world of pain and punishment, that not even her bodyguard, Tristan Thomas, can save her from. In this heart-breaking conclusion of the Salt Kiss trilogy, what will Mark do when he realizes he's hurt the one's he loved... and how far will he go to get them back?
6a8387a6232923bdbe0d2b5b.title: Bitter Burn

6a83ba69f394891af803e5fb.synopsis: Serlanty, East Sea mermaid princess, was drained of golden scales by her family and lover. The bastard Winsil stole her credit. She traded the Heart of the Ocean for human form, defeated evil with the Land King and found true love.
6a83ba69f394891af803e5fb.title: The Mermaid Queen’s Revenge

6a83bdc05777e714af07985d.synopsis: Sold to a drug lord by her foster father, Aurora leaps from a tower and is reborn. She exposes the Harrisons' abuse, then her sealed wolf awakens, revealing her as Alpha King Vincent's long-lost daughter. Vincent brings Aurora home to a noble academy where she crushes every challenger. Three adopted brothers discover they are all her destined mates. At her coronation, Aurora exposes the Harrisons' crimes and Vincent banishes them. All three brothers declare love, leaving her choice open.
6a83bdc05777e714af07985d.title: The Alpha King's True Heiress

6a850ad852dd63c43c0d188a.synopsis: For years, demigod Elena endured the arrogance and cruelty of Alec, Sovereign of Olympus—only to have him reject her on her eighteenth birthday. But fate gives her a second chance when she meets Stefano, the powerful King of the Titans. His choice is immediate and public, "I want her. No one else." Just as Elena finally finds her true match, Alec and his lover set out to destroy them. Can Elena escape their trap, and will Stefano save her in time?
6a850ad852dd63c43c0d188a.title: Forbidden Bonds: Fated to the Ocean God

6a850bd3bcb5cab4b00acb6b.synopsis: In the Mecha Age, girls who turn 18 can transform into powerful mechas and go to the battlefield, while men can become Pilots and lead them to glory in combat. Ethan awakens as an SSS-rank Pilot. Waiting for him are beautiful Mecha Girls, each with her own unique personality, advanced combat skills, ever-evolving weapons and energy systems. But every victory only leads him to more challenges, where even his SSS-rank power will be put to the ultimate test. As his enemies go after him, Ethan must grow stronger, master his Mecha Girls, and fight his way toward the top.
6a850bd3bcb5cab4b00acb6b.title: Race and Rise: My Machine Girls

6a850d12889c4164400b645b.synopsis: In My Immortal Love movie, after being fired and betrayed on her birthday, Lana’s life takes a supernatural turn when she becomes the first person in 2,000 years to see Augustus—a cursed, invisible Roman immortal. Believing Lana is his destined "miracle," Augustus begs her to help break his eternal curse. There's just one deadly catch: to set him free, she must kill him. As they grow closer and undeniable sparks fly, Lana is torn between her deepening love and the cruel fate demanding his sacrifice. Can they defeat the ancient gods and break the curse without losing each other, or is their romance doomed?
6a850d12889c4164400b645b.title: My Immortal Love

6a850fc824d230ed1b0b190d.synopsis: Pampered real alpha princess Evie is framed and sent to the ruthless Werewolf Military Academy by her own family. They believe she is living comfortably, completely unaware that under the fake alpha princess's orders, Evie suffers brutal abuse. Three years later, she returns, broken inside, yet her family still views her as a spoiled brat. It is only when her father strikes her and her prosthetic limb falls off that they finally realize the horrifying truth...
6a850fc824d230ed1b0b190d.title: The Alpha Princess Is Gone for Good

6a8512e427fe8a27b30e0e9b.synopsis: At a superpower‑fueled academy where strength reigns supreme, ordinary girl Sophie unexpectedly awakens the extremely rare ability of Future Sight. Yet the very first vision she sees of the future shows her locked in a passionate kiss with Damien, the campus’s cold‑hearted, sharp‑tongued student council president! Convinced this could never happen, Sophie is determined to keep her distance from him. But fate plays a cruel joke on her: that very same night, her mother remarries‑‑and Damien suddenly becomes her stepbrother. As the embrace and shared bed from her prophecy start coming true one after another, misunderstandings and romantic tension between them keep building amid their cohabitation and school life.
6a8512e427fe8a27b30e0e9b.title: Fleeing The Future I Saw With Him

6a851b09ab33cb2fc3071f11.synopsis: Wendy, a naturally gifted ballet prodigy, had her identity maliciously swapped at birth by Helena, a former dancer consumed by jealousy. For eighteen years, she endured abuse and suppression, yet quietly clung to her dream of dancing. To cover her grandfather’s medicalsurgery expenses, she took a job at a theatre and signed up for a competition. However, Angela, the impostor heiress, repeatedly framed her. Worse still, her birth mother Sophia wrongfully accused her of plagiarism, getting her blacklisted across the industry.In her darkest hour, Alexander, a corporate CEO, recognized her talent and resilience. He funded her grandfather’s surgery and supported her as she competed in the International Dance Invitational. Wendy triumphed with her outstanding skill and staged a remarkable comeback. As the truth about her birth unfolded, Angela resorted to desperate measures and orchestrated a car crash, only for all her crimes to come to light. In the end, Wendy reunites with her birth mother, rises to the pinnacle of international ballet, and finds sincere loveachieving a double triumph in both her career and life.
6a851b09ab33cb2fc3071f11.title: Revenge of the Black Swan

6a85414c421ba4d3f6041e98.synopsis: I dated Lucien secretly for three years, but he denied me at graduation after a heartbeat test paired him with his rival Seraphina. He even stole my umbrella and altered my overseas academy admission. I cut all contact and flew to Arcadia to rebuild myself. Years later, he traveled thousands of miles to beg for a second chance. Yet I met Nathan, a sincere mage who treats me as an equal. Will I ever forgive the boy who broke me completely?
6a85414c421ba4d3f6041e98.title: Outgrowing My Old Magic Love

6a8570a4b135de64bb02b3a3.synopsis: Kaelen, the strongest Alpha of his werewolf clan, struggles with fertility. His grandfather arranges a marriage with the Chris family to secure an heir. Chris, mistreated at home, flees and works at a bar, where she is drugged and has a one-night stand with Kaelen, resulting in pregnancy. Kaelen's assistant discovers the pregnancy and informs him. When Chris returns home to borrow money from her stepmother, she is mocked, but Kaelen arrives to rescue her, takes her to the hospital, and insists she keep the baby, promising to protect her.Kaelen punishes the bullies' families. Chris gives birth, and the family lives happily ever after.
6a8570a4b135de64bb02b3a3.title: The Barren Alpha Knocked Me Up with Twins

6a8578386aae77f5520dbc8f.synopsis: twenty‑year‑ago, top gambler Alexander was framed by Calvin, losing everything and turned into a puppet. His daughter Ivy, abandoned back then, grows up with extraordinary gambling gifts. She heads to Las Vegas, gambles at the enemy’s casino, reunites with her birth mother and half‑brother. After deadly showdowns including a face‑off against her controlled father, Ivy kills the villain, settles old scores and rises as the new gambling god.
6a8578386aae77f5520dbc8f.title: The Last Ace

6a857d2914793f87470ee412.synopsis: Rejected by his royal family and cast into the ocean as a child, Kai secretly becomes the legendary God of Tides. Years later, he returns home in disguise to find the pirate kingdom under siege. Now, Kai must save his family, all the while dealing with a father who thinks that he's worthless.
6a857d2914793f87470ee412.title: The God of Tides

6a85ac81d1dc784c210bf0be.synopsis: Sloane was a fake mate assigned to heir Royce. For three years, he never marked her, spiked her drinks with suppressants, and humiliated her in public. His brother Kael, whose Thorne blood Sloane recognized at a ceremony, returned and proposed a deal: “Three months, he never pleased you once. I need one night.” One true bite shattered the fake bond. Sloane carried Kael's pup. Royce killed Magnus for the seat, kidnapped seven-months-pregnant Sloane, and confessed to everything—recorded live by the ring she wore. Royce was caged for life. Kael knelt before the pack and asked Sloane to be his Luna.
6a85ac81d1dc784c210bf0be.title: Pregnant by His Alpha Brother

6a866c985e8777b04a0da2d9.synopsis: After the Iron Sheep Kingdom falls, Prince Leigh is offered to Kaelen, the Blood Lion King cursed by berserker blood, becoming the “remedy” that keeps him alive. Their reunion awakens a bond forged fourteen years ago. From captor and captive to allies, they uncover the truth behind the kingdom’s fall and the curse. After surviving conspiracies, war, and sacrifice, Leigh reclaims his throne and rules alongside Kaelen.
6a866c985e8777b04a0da2d9.title: Blood Lion: The Sacrificial Cage

6a866ee686fe072a7d03ee5d.synopsis: On a stormy night, during a divine rebellion, the drugged King of Gods Zeus stumbles into the restaurant of the mortal chef Ruby. After a passionate night, he leaves behind a silver ring and disappears. Ruby gives birth to five adorable demigod children and raises them alone. Eight years later, Zeus returns as the billionaire CEO Alexander, while the five powerful kids secretly test their absentee father. The jealous goddess Amelia teams up with Hades to hunt down the family. In their darkest hour, Zeus fights valiantly while the children awaken their divine powers to protect their mother. With the crisis resolved, Zeus kneels before his mortal wife in the divine realm, making her a solemn promise.
6a866ee686fe072a7d03ee5d.title: I Secretly Gave Birth to God's Five Babies

6a86ae6abe4bd8008005b2c5.synopsis: Thirteen years ago, a traitorous scheme tore the Bloodwolf Clan apart. The true-born princess, still just a child, was cast out in the wild, losing all memory of who she really was. At nineteen, she awakens the overpowering Progenitor's Power. Returning home, she finds her Mother tortured, her father paralyzed, and the traitors colluding with the enemy to destroy the clan from the inside.
