Will the true-born princess be able to reclaim her throne and save her people?
6a86ae6abe4bd8008005b2c5.title: The Wolfless Alpha Queen

6a86ae7ebdc72d00bb0bf1d1.synopsis: After years of being dismissed by her husband, Eric, as uptight, boring, and hopelessly inexperienced, Chloe finally decides she’s had enough. Desperate to save her dying marriage—and prove she can be the woman he wants—she ventures into an exclusive underground club for a private lesson in pleasure. But Chloe walks into the wrong room. What she mistakes for an elite adults-only training session is actually a secret gathering where vampires select their human blood thralls. And the man she approaches for guidance is no ordinary instructor. Victor is a ruthless billionaire, a predator hiding at the very top of human society—and a powerful vampire Dom accustomed to complete obedience. Unaware of what he truly is, Chloe asks him to teach her how to submit. One forbidden night leaves Victor craving far more than her blood. Using her desire to save her marriage as bait, he offers her a dangerous arrangement: become his sub, obey his every command, and serve as his exclusive blood thrall……
6a86ae7ebdc72d00bb0bf1d1.title: Private Lessons with My Vampire Boss

6a86b34714749afb8806c3f2.synopsis: Pierce threw Sloane's newborn into lava, carved out her dragon heart-core, and left her to die on the storm altar. Reborn seven years earlier, Sloane watches him choose her sister, convinced Mira will bear the golden heir Sloane never could. She lets him walk into his own ruin and binds herself to Corvin, a cursed raven everyone mocks. Then Mira's golden egg hatches a black serpent, while Sloane's single egg reveals twins: a Supreme Gold Dragon and a Blackwing royal. Pierce was only a serpent in stolen scales, and the raven he despised was the true Dragon King.
6a86b34714749afb8806c3f2.title: Reborn, I Gave Birth to the True Dragon King's Twins

6a86c823feaf9677a7003453.synopsis: Briar gave everything to her elite dragon flight and her fiancé, Silas. Her reward? Betrayal. They mocked her unawakened dragon as a useless runt, stripped her of her rank, and left her to die. But death didn't take. Reborn back to a few days ago, Briar turns her back on her toxic ex. While they laugh at her "weak" dragon, Briar is ready to unleash a mythical power unseen for centuries. When the skies clash, Silas will realize too late: they didn't just discard a useless teammate—they threw away the goddess of victory.
6a86c823feaf9677a7003453.title: Reborn to Rule the Sky with My Dragon

6a86d7af2cbc4fabd2093406.synopsis: Newlywed wife Emma was on her honeymoon in Hawaii when her husband Jack arranged for her father-in-law Victor to teach her how to surf. The husband was piloting a motorboat ahead, sharing a surfboard with Emma. Victor tightly hugged Emma from behind, experiencing a sustained and secretive desire that gradually spiraled out of control amidst the intense waves. Emma and Victor engaged in a forbidden love affair.
6a86d7af2cbc4fabd2093406.title: Tide of Forbidden Touch

6a86d93f2cf533b6910425ea.synopsis: Framed by her pack, Leila was thrown into the Howling Chasm and lost her arm. Two years later, her cruel family forces her to marry the North’s rumored “mad wolf,” Darian. But Darian is not mad—he is her fiercest protector. When her grandmother reveals that Leila is the true Alpha’s daughter, the impostor’s schemes collapse. Awakening her dormant wolf powers, Leila rejects her unworthy family and walks away with Darian into a new life under the blood moon.
6a86d93f2cf533b6910425ea.title: The Furless One

6a8752ac7c23cb02b40f062b.synopsis: Based on the Wattpad novel by Emily Jean. Determined to lose her virginity before she starts college, Farrah Blake strikes a deal with her best friend and crush since forever, the billionaire heir Ethan Sinclair, who will find the perfect guy for her first time, or take her v-card himself.
6a8752ac7c23cb02b40f062b.title: Just One Kiss

6a87ad8d444b7845c203ccc2.synopsis: In A Farm Girl's Reckoning movie, bound by her late father's dying wish, ex-special forces soldier Hanna Carter buried her past and settled into quiet farm life, marrying Jake and raising their five kids together. For years his family lived off her sacrifice. Then Jake turned on her, showing up with his mistress to demand a divorce while his family schemed to steal the farm and throw Hanna and her children out. Cornered at last, Hanna stops holding back — and Jake's family realizes too late she was never just a farm girl.
6a87ad8d444b7845c203ccc2.title: A Farm Girl's Reckoning

6a87af9a9e28e3c0cf039b2e.synopsis: Princess Valerie marries the ruthless Dragon King Therak to save her kingdom. But their wedding night hides a deadly game. Beneath her pillow lies the dagger meant for his heart. In his veins flows a curse: devour her before the Blood Moon, or die. Yet when danger strikes, Therak risks his life to protect her. Enemies by fate, lovers by choice. The Blood Moon rises. One must die.
6a87af9a9e28e3c0cf039b2e.title: The Virgin Sacrifice the Dragon King Claims

6a87ee06934ea2f4e1022043.synopsis: Ryder and Enzo, F1 rivals for fourteen years, one from the slums, one a billionaire heir. Enzo whispers "I love you" during CPR; Ryder wakes convinced it was sabotage. Handcuffs, saunas, and blindfold drills force them close as Ryder battles desire. Enzo risks his life against a violent rival and quietly pays Ryder's mother's surgery. They confess at the track where it began. In the final race, Enzo pushes Ryder to victory with his own car and crashes. In the wreckage, Ryder says "I love you."
6a87ee06934ea2f4e1022043.title: T-Boning my F1 Rival

6a87fc75cd1a6219260b2137.synopsis: When the Duke dies suddenly, his greedy brother Richard steals the title and fortune. Overnight, Cordelia—the Duke’s only daughter—is stripped of her nobility and secretly blinded in a vicious plot. To protect her commoner lover, Luke, she brutally breaks his heart and drives him away. Believing she abandoned him for status, Luke leaves for the frontier, fueled by hatred. Years later, Luke returns as Luciano Thorne, the Empire's most powerful war hero and new Duke. Meanwhile, Cordelia is trapped at home, desperately guarding what's left of her inheritance. When her uncle forces the blind Cordelia to marry a 70-year-old merchant, Luciano arrives with an immense dowry to claim her himself. Luciano intends to punish her for the "betrayal." But seeing her scars and suffering, his hatred turns back into obsession. As they get caught up in revenge and irresistible attraction, the truth finally comes to light. Ultimately, the feared war god bows only to her, restoring her sight and placing the ducal crown back on the woman he has always worshiped.
6a87fc75cd1a6219260b2137.title: Forced to Marry My Ruined Ex: The Duke's Revenge

6a880526b1226d1e92057951.synopsis: The human girl Lena is sacrificed to Draven, a Vampire King afflicted by a petrification curse, and the two unexpectedly forge a life-binding blood pact. To save Draven—who is left dying and drained of his royal blood after the curse is broken—Lena endures seven years of perilous hardships to locate the source of the Blood Spring and rescue her true love. Ultimately, they ascend the throne side by side, ruling over a kingdom where humans and vampires coexist. Yet, just as peace dawns, the sigil of an ancient witch quietly begins to glow red deep within the Blood Spring...
6a880526b1226d1e92057951.title: The Stone-Cursed King’s Blood Bride

6a880a1758adcf20550a8502.synopsis: Serena Hale was a devoted wife. But her husband hadn't touched her in months. So when a stranger pulled her from a bar one night, she surrendered to him - because in her drugged haze, she thought he was her husband. One mistake. That stranger is Evan Knight - the billionaire underworld king now funding her husband's company. He knows she's married. He doesn't care. He's been waiting for her for sixteen years - since the rainy night she saved a beaten boy in an alley and didn't even remember his face. But he remembered everything. Her piano. Her voice. The way the rain clung to her white dress. Now he sits across from her at every dinner, watches her husband fake devotion, and whispers: "You don't belong to him." And the worst part? She's starting to agree. Even as she discovers that her husband murdered her parents. Even as she plans her revenge. There's only one man she trusts with the blade. But trusting him means betraying herself. And she's already fallen for him.
6a880a1758adcf20550a8502.title: My Protective Mafia Lover

6a8ba46f8b785bc6d401045c.synopsis: Cassia, the Wingless Goddess, was born a scapegoat for fake‑princess Celine. Mis‑prophesied as a doomsday omen at birth, she was abandoned by her birth father. Raised under the protection of her adoptive father, she awakens the legendary divine wings. She exposes that fake‑princess Celine is the real destroyer behind everything. Finally, she overthrows the corrupt Wing‑Caste system and ascends the throne as the new queen.
6a8ba46f8b785bc6d401045c.title: The Wingless God

6a8ba4d6a8896f1ec604191b.synopsis: Asher secretly dated QB Chase for six months. Chase never went public—instead he played the perfect couple with Asher's sister Daisy. A naked photo of Asher leaked across campus. Daisy stole it from Chase's phone. Chase told Asher to stay quiet and kept using him. Hockey captain Finn opened Instagram in front of everyone: “Want to date? Follow me first.” Next day, he held Asher's hand in the hallway—fingers laced, for everyone to see. Daisy faked a nut allergy attack to frame Asher. Asher shoved her head into a fountain. Chase lost his game and screamed at Daisy on the sideline—his golden image shattered. Finn won, looked at the camera, and said: “Our goalie held two periods alone. I didn't want him carrying it alone anymore.” Everyone understood.
6a8ba4d6a8896f1ec604191b.title: The Quarterback’s Secret Darling

6a8ba4ddd9c22677010439b2.synopsis: Sold at auction and cast aside by the Alpha who bought her, Omega Elena is handed off to his vanished uncle—the Lycan King and War God, Finn—only to discover that her five children were his all along, and that the man she thought had betrayed her has loved and protected her from the very start.
6a8ba4ddd9c22677010439b2.title: The Alpha King Sold Me to the War God

6a8bafb465f5c507d0050da9.synopsis: In In Bed with My Brother-in-Law movie, Bella's arranged marriage becomes a nightmare when she catches her fiancé cheating. Seeking revenge, she sleeps with a stranger, unwittingly bedding her fiancé's powerful mafia boss brother, Damian Gotti. Forced back into the Gotti family, Bella faces dangerous secrets and forbidden desires. Damian relentlessly pursues her under his brother's nose. Eventually, Damian exposes his brother's crimes, saves Bella, and they unite to defend their mafia throne.
6a8bafb465f5c507d0050da9.title: In Bed with My Brother-in-Law

6a8bb018f862ce484b00710a.synopsis: Tammy is a single mom who needs money to look for her son. Desperate for work, Tammy takes a a wet nurse job in a powerful manor, never guessing the cold, intimidating master is the father of her son. Nor that her touch alone breaks his years-long trauma with women. What he doesn't know is that he's about to hire her.
6a8bb018f862ce484b00710a.title: CEO's Irresistible Wet Nurse

6a8bb563f6d48b075604db4a.synopsis: She faked her death. Three years later, Sierra comes back to her own funeral with a new identity. She takes down her unfaithful ex and her best friend who betrayed her. She vows to take her three-year-old son back. For revenge, she teams up with Julian, the heir to the most powerful family. In a game of power, they go from sworn enemies to each other's only hope. Finally the truth comes out. They take everything back and find their way back to each other.
6a8bb563f6d48b075604db4a.title: Faked My Death, Destroyed The Billionaire

6a8bb851ca13d8a5ab03d72c.synopsis: On the eve of her wedding, Sloane enters heiress Vivienne Vale's husband selection gala and finds her own groom holding the winning red card. Reid places Sloane's wedding ring on Vivienne and publicly casts her aside, certain she will crawl back. Instead, Sloane accepts a secret proposal from Vivienne's wheelchair-bound billionaire brother, Dane. When Reid and Vivienne leave Sloane beaten and her father fighting for his life, Dane steps in to protect the woman he has searched for and loved for ten years.
6a8bb851ca13d8a5ab03d72c.title: I Married the Other Woman's Billionaire Brother

6a8bb9be6d46f8503907eeb8.synopsis: To save her daughter, Harper Reed marries Klaus Wolfe—New York's most feared mafia godfather—in her stepsister's place. On the wedding day, he sees right through her and calls her a gold digger. He gives her one choice: jump into a shark pool, or watch her whole family die. Then she jumps without hesitation. That shatters his frozen heart. But she finds out that—this marriage is way worse than death. Lydia deeply hates her. Uncle Richard wants the Don's chair. And "Black Fox" is dragging everyone to hell...
6a8bb9be6d46f8503907eeb8.title: 100-Day Contract：Mafia’s Dangerous Desire

6a8bbc709c6562e0640a54ee.synopsis: Medieval times. Dragons rule the continent. Lydia is forced by her family to marry the "savage" Dragon King, Lucian, in her sister's place. She flees into the night — and in a blizzard-buried cabin, she encounters a dragon-shifter whose power is spiraling out of control. To save him, she gives him her virginity... The next day, she is captured. Her secret dragon pregnancy is exposed, and she is branded an unclean sinner, dragged onto the trial platform. Meanwhile, Lucian searches for her frantically, tearing a scale from his own heart to cast a tracking spell. When the crystal ball reveals the truth — that Lydia is the woman who saved him, unintentionally carrying his heir — and with Lydia's life hanging by a thread, he descends from the sky to pull her into his arms and declare to all: she is his only bride.
6a8bbc709c6562e0640a54ee.title: Fate of the Dragon’s Bride

6a8bdf3ebd867eff6d05018d.synopsis: Lucas returns to LA as the mysterious CEO of Apex Group, ready to marry his beloved girlfriend, Evelyn. But Evelyn mistakes him for a nobody and leaves him for a "richer man." Little does she know, she just dumped the most powerful billionaire in LA. Then, a stunning female CEO enters Lucas’s life and she gets down on one knee and proposes to Lucas. CEO meets CEO. Together, they become the most powerful couple in the world and make every idiot who underestimated them regret it!
6a8bdf3ebd867eff6d05018d.title: Fake Husband, Hidden King

6a8be7a9a53aea0fed0573cb.synopsis: Freya, a female rabbit beastkin, was adopted by Lady Hughes, her mother’s best friend, after her parents passed away. She grew up and attended school alongside Landon and Marcel, the twin wolf beastkin brothers of the Hughes household. The twins were popular celebrities at the beastkin academy. Leveraging her rabbit-type healing powers, Freya tirelessly helped them resolve all kinds of troubles, fully believing she would marry one of the two brothers someday. Everything fell apart the moment Charlotte, a fox beastkin, appeared. Charlotte schemed relentlessly to frame Freya and drive her away. She successfully manipulated the wolf twins into misunderstanding Freya, creating a rift between them. Tormented and wronged, Freya drifted apart from the brothers. Overcome with despair, she resolved to transfer schools and wed Grayson, the young heir of a lion beastkin clan. Only after Freya left did the Hughes twins wake up to the truth, see Charlotte the fox beastkin’s true colors clearly, and drown in remorse. Yet it was far too late. Freya was already with Grayson, had completely let go of the past, and was preparing for their wedding.
6a8be7a9a53aea0fed0573cb.title: The Wolves’ Regret for Their Rabbit

6a8d05f8e54f27846a094f51.synopsis: Thrown into the freezing rain by her mobster husband for being "fat and worthless," Hannah is left with nothing. Desperate for shelter, she accepts a midnight emergency call to nanny for a traumatized toddler. She arrives at a breathtaking estate, only to discover her new employer is Don Lucian Moretti—New York’s most feared mafia kingpin. While her ex replaced her with a cruel social climber, the legendary boss offers her respect, a million-dollar life, and a unyielding protection. When her ex begs on his knees, it’s too late. The rejected wife is now the Mafia Queen.
6a8d05f8e54f27846a094f51.title: The Mob Boss’s Plus-Size Queen

6a8d096d10f3a4bb8309daa7.synopsis: After Dante Conti let his mistress Selena Russo torment their six-year-old daughter Sofia, Isabella Moretti fought back and was locked inside Ashford Sanitarium. Years later, Dante forced her to sign away her rights with Sofia’s urn as a threat, believing he had broken her forever. But Sicily turned the abandoned wife into Don Moretti. Backed by Luca Ricci, the Don of Palermo, and the hidden power of her father Vittorio, Isabella returns to New York’s Five Families banquet to expose Selena’s lies, reclaim her empire, and make Dante watch the Conti throne collapse for every drop of blood he spilled.
6a8d096d10f3a4bb8309daa7.title: The Don's Bloody Bride

6a8d0f21a52fd87cd5018f9a.synopsis: Five years after breaking up with his college sweetheart Nora, successful ad man Ben unexpectedly reunites with her as his new partner at work. But whenever Ben reveals his true feelings, his consciousness is thrown back five years into his younger self. Determined to fix the mistakes that ended their relationship, Ben begins rewriting the past—only to discover that every change can reshape the present. To win Nora back, he must finally face the one thing he has always avoided: telling her the truth.
6a8d0f21a52fd87cd5018f9a.title: Love Has A Deadline

6a8d2d531616ebd404056b3e.synopsis: When the apocalypse descended, Anya, a girl with severe social anxiety, deliberately infected herself to escape both survival and socializing. Unexpectedly, she retained her human consciousness and became a “freak zombie” with absolutely no combat power. She shouldered her backpack and embarked on a southbound road trip in search of her family. Along the way, her innate kindness led her to save survivors time and again. She met Zane, a cold and ruthless human killing machine; Leon, a fellow zombie male lead with overwhelming combat prowess; and Mia, a mad virologist. She also adopted an apocalypse-level adorable zombie dog. To find her family and uncover the truth behind the virus, the three people and one dog formed a quirky wasteland team, beginning a trope-defying, laugh-out-loud healing journey through the apocalypse.
6a8d2d531616ebd404056b3e.title: A Zombie Girl’s Journey Home

6a8d59cabdf43642fe0e20ab.synopsis: To the world, Nate Ryder is a failure whose Awakening ended in disgrace. But Nate knows the truth: he awakened the SSS-rank Thunder God—the rarest power on Earth. His father sold his health for a vial of Awakening serum. His mother has been paralyzed for ten years, yet she's the reason he never gives up. At school, the elite bully Tyler—an A-rank prodigy—crushes that serum and works with corrupt administrators to bar Nate from the national tournament. Facing relentless humiliation, Nate hides his power and bides his time. Every insult, every injustice becomes fuel for his training. Then the Federal Awakened Selection Tournament begins. Tyler, determined to defeat Nate in front of thousands, steps into the arena—expecting a hopelessly one-sided fight. Instead, Nate unleashes his SSS-rank Thunder God. In one electrifying moment, the "worthless failure" shocks the world—and begins his unstoppable rise to the top.
6a8d59cabdf43642fe0e20ab.title: SSS-Rank: The Slum-Born Thunder God

6a8d881ef77dbccff405a729.synopsis: Wealthy heiress Vivian Sterling publicly breaks her engagement after catching fiancé Bryce with her stepsister. Having secretly recovered from paralysis months ago, she stands from her wheelchair to reclaim her power. That night, she meets Adrian, a dangerous, motorcycle-riding mechanic who saves her from harassment. After a one-night stand, she proposes a contract marriage to escape Bryce's stalking. Vivian believes Adrian is merely a handsome working-class man, unaware he is the true heir to the Hale dynasty—and Bryce's most feared uncle. A decade earlier, Adrian was the one who pulled her from a fatal car crash and bore the scars; Bryce stole the credit and her ten years of devotion. As Vivian falls for Adrian, Bryce and his father Gerald launch a campaign of kidnapping, media manipulation, corporate traps, and assassination. When Adrian is rushed into the ER covered in blood, Vivian finally discovers the man she married for revenge is her real rescuer and only true love. What began as a contract marriage escalates into a high-stakes war for love, fortune, and survival.
6a8d881ef77dbccff405a729.title: I Married My Cheating Ex's Uncle

6a8d8d3da68a8219800ca210.synopsis: Klare is an overlooked nurse at Venus Hospital, struggling with severe anxiety after a family tragedy. Her only comfort is submitting online to a mysterious “Master,” whose commands make her feel safe. But in real life, her new boss, Dance Gordon, is arrogant, sharp-tongued, and always targeting her. By day, they clash at the hospital. By night, he is the perfect Master behind the screen, giving all his patience and tenderness to his one and only — “Cake.” Enemies in real life. Addicted online.
6a8d8d3da68a8219800ca210.title: He Paid for One Night, Then Wanted Forever

6a8e42ef484c07df8a01bcce.synopsis: Catherine, pregnant and controller of FG Group, catches her husband Jesse cheating on video with mistress Mia. She brings his disabled father Walter to the billiard parlor, where Mia shatters Catherine's family crest necklace, smokes illegally, and brutally assaults both the pregnant Catherine and elderly Walter—almost killing the unborn child. When Jesse arrives, he takes Mia's side—until he learns Walter is his biological father and Mia has committed grievous bodily harm. Business tycoon John Morgan, who had cut ties with Jesse, watches Catherine's abuse live. He arrives, reveals his true identity, and shatters Jesse's business hopes. Jesse and Mia slander Catherine, but she files suit with full evidence of assault, adultery, and illegal fund diversion. They are arrested and imprisoned. A year later, Catherine makes the Forbes list. John Morgan proposes publicly. Catherine lets go of the past and begins a new life.
6a8e42ef484c07df8a01bcce.title: Make my cheating husband pay the price

6a8e44fcd712caa73e051f91.synopsis: Raised on her Grandma's one unbreakable rule, stay away from serpents, she never expects to save a heavily wounded man in the forest. Little does she know, the man she's saved is the feared Silver Serpent King, Silvan. He's made up his mind and has marked her as his. On Bella's wedding day, he crashes the ceremony and declares her his in front of everyone. Desperate to escape this possessive monster, Bella decides to run away with her childhood sweetheart. But to her shock, the man she trusts most betrays her and offers her up as a sacrifice. Betrayed, hunted, and on the edge of death, the man she once feared most becomes the only one left protecting her.
6a8e44fcd712caa73e051f91.title: The Silver Serpent's Bride

6a8e4b2d31276c556c080e56.synopsis: A witch cursed Prince Alexander to sleep for a century. Only a Jones daughter's kiss can break it. Catherine, once bound to Prince Arthur who chose her half-sister, enters Vandros Castle and awakens Alexander through a three-night ritual. His soul had escaped as a bat, guarding her since childhood. They fall in love. Arthur storms their wedding, but Catherine rejects him. Two princes duel on a cliff. She chooses Alexander. Arthur falls to a fiery end. They wed, sealed by blood and heart.
6a8e4b2d31276c556c080e56.title: A Hundred Years of You

6a8e4e0c2fbe2915aa00b6f2.synopsis: Six years ago, college student Isabel was framed, leading to an unexpected encounter with billionaire heir Ethan, after which she became pregnant and dropped out of school. Six years later, Isabel works tirelessly to raise her child, who suffers from severe allergies. By a twist of fate, she joins Ethan's company and becomes his personal assistant. Faced with relentless bullying and even life-threatening schemes against her child by the vicious heiress Rachel, Isabel refuses to back down and bravely fights back. As they spend time together day and night, Ethan not only repeatedly steps in to save her but also falls deeply in love with her. As the plot unfolds, the child's true bloodline identity is unexpectedly revealed to Ethan's family, specifically his great-grandmother, Olivia. In the end, the malicious Rachel faces the consequences of her actions and is handed over to the police. Isabel unexpectedly becomes pregnant with twins—a boy and a girl—and shares a grand, perfectly happy ending with Ethan.
6a8e4e0c2fbe2915aa00b6f2.title: Secretly Pregnant with the Billionaire's Daughter

6a8e4fc5e108343d2b01885f.synopsis: Six years ago, heiress Milo left penniless Asher to save her failing family, keeping her pregnancy a secret. Now a ruthless tech billionaire still bitter about the past, Asher reunites with Milo at a gala — she’s now a desperate single mom, scrambling to pay for their son Leo’s life-saving heart surgery. As the truth of her sacrifice unfolds, a guilt-stricken Asher sets out to win her back, secures top care for their son, brings the real culprit to justice, and earns his second chance at love...
6a8e4fc5e108343d2b01885f.title: Second Chance: The Tech Billionaire’s Secret Family

6a8e7b7a96ec421187069107.synopsis: Ruby only meant to take a temporary nanny job for quick money, but she accidentally walks into the frozen world of billionaire Ethan Cole and his impossible twins. The children have already driven away sixteen nannies, Ethan runs his home like a boardroom, and every corner of the estate is ruled by cold order instead of warmth. What begins as a one-week trial quickly turns into something much larger. As Ruby challenges the household’s rigid rules, the twins slowly begin to trust again, Ethan is forced to confront the way he confuses control with parenting, and an external power struggle over custody, inheritance, and corporate leadership starts closing in. Caught between family politics and emotional chaos, Ruby becomes the first person who can truly reach the children—and the first one capable of changing Ethan himself. What started as a hired role becomes something real: she was brought in to play a mother, but she ends up becoming the heart of the family.
6a8e7b7a96ec421187069107.title: Rent-A-Mom for the Billionaire Twins

6a8e7cd3963eb73334012f37.synopsis: Three years after leaving Onyx Stormfire, Serafina meets him again at the Grand Clan Gathering hosted by the Ravenwing clan—only to find another woman at his side. No one knows that Serafina once gave up half of her own dragonfire to save Onyx from death, then pretended she had fallen for his younger brother, Corin, so Onyx would hate her and stop searching for the truth. The divided flame has left her unable to shift, and the last of her dragonfire is fading. She has returned only to see him one final time. When Corin reveals the truth, Onyx risks everything to reach her. Their twin dragonfires finally reunite, saving them both. Locke is exposed as the poisoner behind the conspiracy, while Vessa’s false pregnancy scheme falls apart. At last, Serafina and Onyx become bonded mates, vowing to grow old together.
6a8e7cd3963eb73334012f37.title: I Gave My Flame Up

6a8f2036ce8478256004c687.synopsis: Fay Thompson thought she understood the mafia world -- but the arrival of a scheming rival, a shocking pregnancy, and her lover's arrest will force her to become the Mafia Queen she was always meant to be, or lose Kent Lippert forever.
6a8f2036ce8478256004c687.title: Falling for My Ex's Mafia Dad 2

6a8f9944ad5076b92e00c1b7.synopsis: In I Ditched My Ex and Had Five Babies with His Alpha Dad movie, killed by Ethan, Vivienne is reborn five years prior. She chooses Richard, Ethan's father and the clan's strongest Alpha. A fated red thread proves them true mates. Carrying his five pups, she passes the Spirit Stele trial, earns divine blessing, and strips Ethan of his title. Ethan takes forbidden drugs, becomes a monster, and kidnaps her. As she falls into the sea, the Ice Lotus awakens the pups' power, lifting them on a golden lotus. Richard slays Ethan, and they wed amid a moonlit flower sea.
6a8f9944ad5076b92e00c1b7.title: I Ditched My Ex and Had Five Babies with His Alpha Dad

6a8f9c5571f9039e440f4c2a.synopsis: At their mate-selection ceremony, Grant rejects Mara in front of both tribes and gives her place to her crying younger sister. He swears it is only temporary. He has forgotten one thing: Mara turns twenty-two in three days. Under tribal law, an unmated woman loses her right to choose, and Mara has already been assigned to the dying Dragon King. Grant expects her father to stop it. Mara accepts the decree. Three days later, as Grant comes to bond with Brenna, one hundred dragon guards arrive at the Hale gates to escort Mara away as their future queen.
6a8f9c5571f9039e440f4c2a.title: Sister Stole My Mate, I Got the Dragon King

6a8fd24721a38cbb22013f3d.synopsis: Evelyn, an ordinary high school student, is publicly humiliated after her crush on a popular hockey player is exposed. Devastated, she musters up the courage to send him nudes anonymously in hopes of catching his eye. But she accidentally sends the pics to Colton instead, the captain of the hockey team who always teases her. What will happen between them?
6a8fd24721a38cbb22013f3d.title: A Spicy Text to My Nemesis

6a8febce22ae833a4c0170cf.synopsis: Laila, a destitute widow, is forced off a cliff by the tyrannical Governor Barrow—only to fall into the sacred dragon realm. There, she spends one fateful night with King Kael, a dragon sovereign bound by a deadly curse that burns any woman he touches. Ten months later, she gives birth to a royal dragon egg. Hunted by Barrow, she desperately entrusts the egg to the dragon clan. When the temple issues a decree seeking one who can hatch the egg, Laila tears down the royal notice and steps forward. Despite scorn and humiliation from the nobles, she reunites with Kael. In the end, it is her unconditional mother's love that awakens the dying egg—and a penniless commoner becomes the mother of the dragon clan's sole heir.
6a8febce22ae833a4c0170cf.title: Pregnant with the Dragon Lord's Last Heir

6a8ff3b28f0795e2880ba0dd.synopsis: Shivon has spent her life dreaming of escaping her cruel family and earning a place at the Royal Academy. But after one reckless night with the mysterious Duke Alaric Blackmoor, she discovers she’s carrying the one thing everyone believed impossible—his child. Alaric was thought incapable of producing an heir, because a wolf can only conceive with his fated mate. Now, as Shivon’s family tries to sell her to the ruthless Lord Greyfang, Alaric will stop at nothing to find the woman who may be his one true mate—and protect the impossible heir growing inside her.
6a8ff3b28f0795e2880ba0dd.title: Knocked Up by the Wolf Duke

6a9001d1d85aa8495c0398a3.synopsis: Ethan Voss, heir to the ultra‑wealthy Voss conglomerate, fell in love with Clara, an ordinary girl, under a concealed identity. He was left comatose after a car accident and vanished for six years. Clara held fast on her own, gave birth to their daughter, and scraped by on odd‑job work. Upon regaining consciousness, Ethan made behind‑the‑scenes arrangements to make amends to his beloved. He threw a lavish top‑tier wedding to humiliate his snobbish relatives, finally revealed his true identity, and walked hand‑in‑hand with Clara toward a happy ending.
6a9001d1d85aa8495c0398a3.title: The Billion-Dollar Heir's Six-Year Secret Bride

6a90ea2c3140b63d0f073a2c.synopsis: Sabrina wakes from a crash to find her husband cheating with her best friend. To steal her $5 billion trust, he "gives" her to his Mafia uncle, Silas. She fakes amnesia and uses Silas's power to destroy them both—exposing fake pregnancy, stealing deals, sending her husband to prison. When she tries to leave, Silas corners her: "You took ten years to reach me. Now you want to run?" He waited in the shadows for a decade—and finally turns her from a bargaining chip into his bride.
6a90ea2c3140b63d0f073a2c.title: The Mafia's Stolen Bride

6a90edce12fd232313065336.synopsis: Scarlett, a kind‑hearted and resilient delivery rider, enters a flash marriage with Ethan, the CEO of Imperial Group who is disguised as a poor young man, in order to hold onto her late mother’s keepsakes. As they live together after marriage, feelings gradually blossom between them. Behind the scenes, Ethan helps her resolve workplace crises. When his true identity as a corporate president comes to light, his former fiancée teams up with their bitter rival to set her up. Amid life‑threatening danger, Scarlett recognizes her true feelings, and the two finally rebuild their trust hand‑in‑hand.
6a90edce12fd232313065336.title: The Secret Billionaire's Unexpected Bride

6a9102ace5c9db03f30c43ef.synopsis: Beast King Elden bears a lethal lightning curse—any living thing he touches burns to cinders. Human girl Vera is the only one who can endure his touch. To break the curse, he forces her into marriage by holding her mother hostage. Vera resents him, but glimpses his sincere heart: he heals her, shields her, and crumbles when she prays for him barefoot through brambles. The curse can be broken by consummation—but Vera would die from the backlash. Elden makes an antidote, but the villainess Lia swaps it for poison. On their wedding night, the curse lifts—but Vera collapses, never to wake. Elden mourns her for six years at her grave. But Vera is alive, raising twin children with golden beast ears in the human slums. One snowy day, her daughter clings to a passing man's leg—"Daddy." Elden finds his lost family. But Vera cannot forgive his deception, and an old enemy's father has raised a poison bow, vowing blood revenge.
6a9102ace5c9db03f30c43ef.title: Bound to the Ruthless Beast

6a9123fa3fc3c5a93a04b399.synopsis: Leo has always been one rank behind Jaxon, the star quarterback who takes everything Leo wants, including his crush, the hottest girl on campus. What Leo doesn't know is that Jaxon is secretly in love with him. So Jaxon tanks an exam on purpose, then makes Leo an offer — Tutor me to keep my captaincy, and I'll teach you how to win your dream girl. Studying calculus by day, dating lessons by night — and one plan Leo never accounted for, falling for his romance coach, his biggest rival.
6a9123fa3fc3c5a93a04b399.title: Romance Lessons with My Quarterback

6a91653d7b441cad410e390c.synopsis: In The Mafia Boss's Contract Bride movie, Elena signed the divorce papers, penniless, wandering through the rain with her suitcase. A "Wanted: Stepmother" flyer on a deli bulletin board caught her attention. She followed the address, only to find that her employer turned out to be the Marchetti family, the most powerful mafia dynasty on the East Coast.
6a91653d7b441cad410e390c.title: The Mafia Boss's Contract Bride

6a916cb6a07eb2f5bb00297a.synopsis: Billion-dollar conglomerate founder Sarah returns home, keeping her wealth hidden, hoping only for a quiet wedding. Unexpectedly, Hailey, her son's fiancée, humiliates her relentlessly to seize her wedding venue — completely unaware that the victim before her is none other than her fiancé's own mother! Hailey resorts to extreme violence. She shoots Sarah and has her bound and drowned in a resort pool to silence her. Miraculously surviving, Sarah refuses her son's protection. Disguised as a waitress, she infiltrates the engagement gala. Before the city's elite and assembled media, witnesses and irrefutable evidence come to light, exposing Hailey’s full conspiracy: fake-pregnancy fraud, embezzlement, and attempted murder. The villain is publicly ruined. Sarah makes her triumphant return, reclaiming everything that belongs to her!
6a916cb6a07eb2f5bb00297a.title: Fake Angel's Final Fall

6a94d78854bf92589202afac.synopsis: Molly Hart runs a street food truck called Big Molly’s Hot Dogs with her adoptive parents. People love to joke about the name—and about Molly herself—but she never lets it get to her. If anything, she turns it into part of the brand. Meanwhile, Adrian Blackwood, heir to the Blackwood empire, has gone days without being able to eat. The best doctors, private chefs, and nutritionists money can buy have all failed to help him. Then Charles brings one of Molly’s hot dogs back to the estate. What was meant to be a simple meal unexpectedly catches Adrian’s attention. For the first time in days, he willingly takes a bite—and his condition immediately begins to improve. The moment Adrian learns the hot dog came from a food-truck girl named Molly Hart, he sets out to find her. Neither of them expects that a relationship beginning with food, money, and a very unusual arrangement will eventually turn into something neither can walk away from: real dependence, real desire, and real love.
6a94d78854bf92589202afac.title: Big Molly The Billionaire's Only Cure

6a94da44281fc60a7909373a.synopsis: Eva, a cold-blooded assassin, accidentally triggers a deadly curse after killing the man chosen as her soulmate. Her only chance of survival is Leo—a clumsy Cupid apprentice who has failed his divine exam for ten thousand years. Bound by an invisible life thread, they must stay within three meters of each other or die. With only seven days left, the mismatched pair is forced to run from a powerful assassin organization while uncovering a conspiracy that has been manipulating love itself. Eva has never trusted anyone. But when Leo repeatedly risks his life to save hers, she must decide whether love is her greatest weakness—or her only way out.
6a94da44281fc60a7909373a.title: Clumsy Cupid

6a94dc4c834d8e48b901d179.synopsis: The Ph.D. candidate Thea personally taught a lone male dragon courtship calls and the Flame Dance to complete her thesis. The dragon immediately performed the move in front of her after learning it. The mentor's phone call tore open the truth. The courtship ritual involves abducting the mate into the nest and locking them until egg-laying. It's too late now—the claws tear open the roof, and he transforms into a human form to take her away. She dreamed back twelve years in a fever. She had fallen from a cable car and was rescued by a young ancient dragon. After the relationship was established, she imprisoned him in reverse. She opened the cage door and knelt to propose.
6a94dc4c834d8e48b901d179.title: I Taught Him to Court a Mate — He Chose Me

6a94dd9bda8c8b6cd704fe18.synopsis: In You Can't Stop My Super X-Ray Vision movie, after his girlfriend dumps him, Michael, a luxury brand CEO with X-ray vision, uses his powers and confidence to bring down arrogant global influencer bullies, all while winning the heart of his high school's most popular girl.
6a94dd9bda8c8b6cd704fe18.title: You Can't Stop My Super X-Ray Vision

6a94ddb411f2b8c133009eea.synopsis: Ever since my Omega sister saved me from wolfsbane poisoning, she used that life debt to control every detail of my existence—including my wedding. She picked the flowers, designed the theme, and even tried on wedding dresses with my groom while he smiled in delight. Every time I voiced my outrage, they weaponized the past to silence me: "She saved your life! Why are you always acting like the villain?" If they want the wedding so badly, they can keep each other. I discarded my ring and returned to my royal pack, took my throne as Alpha Queen.
6a94ddb411f2b8c133009eea.title: From Puppet Bride to Alpha Queen

6a94de31327cf4d1930976d9.synopsis: Lena has been secretly married to Isaac for a year. She believes they married for love, never realizing she is nothing more than a pawn he uses to satisfy a family rule and qualify for the inheritance. Her false sense of peace shatters when Isaac's debt puts her in the hands of loan sharks. On a stormy night, a drugged Lena fights for her life and escapes, only to be rescued by Jack Kane, the West Coast's most ruthless mafia godfather and the CEO of a multibillion-dollar empire. The man looking at her with obsessive hunger is also her father-in-law.
6a94de31327cf4d1930976d9.title: Shh, Don't Let Him Find Out

6a94df7b94243530c408228d.synopsis: On the day Beatrice catches her husband of eight years cheating, she quietly hands him divorce papers he signs without realizing — starting a thirty-day countdown to freedom. As she dismantles the Belmont family's schemes one by one, she is pulled into the orbit of Damian Crowley, her ex-husband's most feared cousin and the mysterious head of the NobleQuest Group. Revenge, a slow-burning romance, and a long-buried secret about a fire and her own origins begin to surface.
6a94df7b94243530c408228d.title: Obsessed by My Ex's Boss

6a94dfc6525a0f0b0507216a.synopsis: On the continent of Vester, Iso—Supreme Ruler of the Hidden Dragon Dominion—goes into hiding under a humble identity to investigate his mother Saintess Esara's murder. Disguised as an ordinary man, he takes residence in Silvermoon Castle and, honoring an old betrothal, becomes the fiancé of Sera, heiress to the saintess lineage. Sera, however, is obsessed with the legendary Dragon Lord—a mythical figure she has worshipped from afar—and feels only disappointment toward her unremarkable-looking betrothed. She frequently mocks and belittles him, unaware of his true identity. Cardinal Taren of the Orthodox Church, coveting the saintess's power, secretly hires eight renowned Dragon Slayers and rallies noble conspirators to ambush and assassinate Sera time and again. Each time, Iso secretly intervenes, wielding his silver-dragon might to save her. At Dragon Ridge Altar, he finally reveals his true form as the Dragon Lord—yet Sera fails to recognize him. The perils continue: a tavern trap, a royal council coup, and a siege by dark Dragon Slayers—all quietly thwarted by Iso from the shadows. At the climactic final banquet, the Church launches its all-out assault. Iso summons a thousand dragons before the entire assembly, shattering the enemy's ranks. Only then does Sera realize that the "ordinary" fiancé who stood by her all along is the Dragon Lord she so longed to meet. Together, they join forces to counter the Church's conspiracy and uncover the truth behind the past.
6a94dfc6525a0f0b0507216a.title: Secret Dragon

6a94e01145098107520f9f20.synopsis: Dr. Miles Hill is flying with a life-saving kidney for the Zeller family when Jane and her mother sabotage the delivery, destroying the precious organ. Without the transplant, the Zeller patriarch loses his only chance at survival. Jane had dreamed of marrying into the wealthy Zeller family, but her scheme backfires, shattering her hopes of wealth and status overnight.
6a94e01145098107520f9f20.title: Her Dream of Marrying Rich Turned Deadly

6a94e906802350a8530a156c.synopsis: Annie, a human, fell in love with Fenrir, the wolf king, and bore twin half-blood children. Yet they were brutally exiled due to blood prejudice and Mara’s malicious schemes. Five years later, the twins’ werewolf blood awakens unexpectedly, dragging the whole family back into power struggles and deadly hunts. Following the clues, Fenrir uncovers the truth of the past. While protecting his wife and daughters, he exacts revenge on the real mastermind behind all the crimes.
6a94e906802350a8530a156c.title: The Alpha King's Half-Blood Twins

6a94ec3a834d8e48b901d181.synopsis: After his father dies saving the world, he is branded a traitor and his entire clan is destroyed. Ryan vanishes into exile, training in secret for fourteen years. Now Ryan returns to expose the dark mage's conspiracy, clear his father's name.
6a94ec3a834d8e48b901d181.title: Vindication: Blood of the Archmage

6a94f0cc46d3fb23b6034c95.synopsis: He's the strongest Alpha alive—cursed so that anyone who touches him burns to ash. She's a wolfless mage apprentice who fell from the sky straight into his arms… and didn't burn. Desperate to find her fated mate, Aria takes a job as Kael's personal maid, unaware the cold, dangerous Alpha is already falling for her. But a dark prophecy looms: their child will carry a curse far deadlier than his—and bearing it could cost Aria her life. When rivals attack and Aria's life hangs by a thread, Kael will face the deadliest mountain in the world to save her. Because some fates aren't written—they're fought for.
6a94f0cc46d3fb23b6034c95.title: Cursed Alpha’s Fated Luna

6a94f45a2e175c3d910e7135.synopsis: In the underground arenas of a wasteland metropolis, Ryker, an F-rank underdog, risks his life in brutal bare-knuckle fights to save his sister, Lena, from a fatal genetic disease. Driven to the brink, he swallows an ominous Insect King egg offered by the Black Market King, unleashing a terrifying power within himself. Armed with this monstrous ability, Ryker defies class prejudice and claws his way up the ranks, only to find himself steadily mutating into something inhuman. As the dark truth comes to light, he discovers that his sister's illness and his parents' deaths are tied to a sinister imperial conspiracy disguised as human-insect hybridization. With war and a relentless swarm engulfing the city, can Ryker—on the verge of complete metamorphosis—cling to his fading humanity and save the only family he has left?
6a94f45a2e175c3d910e7135.title: I Swallowed the Zerg Overmind's Egg

6a94fac21102a673db08d5e8.synopsis: A broke young woman agrees to be a stranger's wife for ninety days to save her brother from prison — only to learn her "husband" is the billionaire who has spent seventeen years searching for the girl who once saved his life.
6a94fac21102a673db08d5e8.title: Oops! My Fake Husband Got Me Pregnant!

6a9513ea94b7be68f406102f.synopsis: After a one‑night stand, Shirley is horrified to discover her lover Sophia is her stepsister. Terrified, she tries to keep her distance, yet Sophia pursues her relentlessly with bold advances, and they are nearly caught by their blended‑family parents. Overwhelmed by intense attraction, Shirley yields and embarks on a thrilling, forbidden secret romance with her. Professor Sophia grows increasingly reckless, even flirting openly with Shirley at the freshman speech event. Envious Amy sets Shirley up and spreads lies to drive them apart. Heartbroken, Shirley breaks up with Sophia. Abducted by hitmen Amy hired, Shirley learns Sophia is secretly the underworld kingpin. They reconcile. Just as Shirley plucks up courage to go public with their relationship, Sophia’s first love Vivian returns home. Rejected suitor Klein exposes their affair to their families. Amid fierce opposition, Sophia lets go of old grudges. Standing firm in their love, the two finally break free from social prejudices and stay together.
6a9513ea94b7be68f406102f.title: Sinking With My Step‑sister

6a951a615fd77720d3076393.synopsis: After a painful rebirth, Eleanor, once a devoted wife and mother, finds her family's affection reserved for Lydia, her husband William's true love. Betrayed by William's bigamy and her children's cruelty, she abandons them, secretly applying to Harvard. As she builds a new life in science, William and the children, now suffering under Lydia's abuse, realize their loss. They beg for forgiveness, but Eleanor, hardened by their betrayal, coldly rejects them. Choosing her own path, she leaves them behind to embrace a future of independence and self-worth.
6a951a615fd77720d3076393.title: After I Took Back My Love

6a951b15f5e222776e05b7ec.synopsis: A firefighter sets his own home ablaze for his mistress’s drill, trapping his three-year-old daughter inside. The mother watches via security cam, but he dismisses her pleas, calls the child illegitimate, and prioritizes the assessment. As flames consume the nursery, the daughter’s ghost emerges—still apologizing for being “bad.” Only when charred remains, a melted necklace, and final recordings surface does he break down. But forgiveness never comes. The daughter’s last words: “Daddy didn’t love me.” He is arrested; she fades into ash, finally free.
6a951b15f5e222776e05b7ec.title: Firefighter Husband Burned His Daughter, Driven to Desperate Regret

6a951e521102a673db08d5ef.synopsis: Evelyn was once the beloved human daughter of four mighty Norse god-kings. But when the false saintess Freya framed her, the fathers who raised her chose to believe a liar. They stripped her blessing, tortured her soul, stole her blood, and forced her to beg for death. Only after Evelyn truly dies do they discover the truth: Freya was the monster all along, and Evelyn's real mother has been trapped beneath the World Tree. Now the gods want their daughter back. But the little girl they destroyed no longer wants to return.
6a951e521102a673db08d5ef.title: Daughter of the Four Norse God-Kings

6a951fac6e99d6bfe505e0dc.synopsis: In Tempted by my bad boy stepbrother movie, Olivia has secretly loved her stepbrother Jacob for years — but ever since their parents' wedding, he's treated her like a stranger. He races motorcycles and lives on the edge; she's the golden girl who never breaks a rule. When one reckless night forces them together, buried feelings start clawing their way to the surface. Some lines were never meant to be crossed.
6a951fac6e99d6bfe505e0dc.title: Tempted by My Bad Boy Stepbrother

6a9545d6d55acb83c70423d7.synopsis: Four years ago, healer Seraphina saved cursed Infernal Legion commander Drake and gave birth to twins. Unaware of his identity, she was exiled by her family and raised the children alone. Years later, the wounded Drake is found by the kids and brought home. He falls for Seraphina at first sight and proposes firmly. Amid stepmother's persecution, brother's power grab and dark magic crisis, they uncover the truth of their past. Finally Drake inherits the Lord of the North, and the family of four lives happily together.
6a9545d6d55acb83c70423d7.title: The Inferno Warlord's Secret Healer Bride

6a962bb32b4cbe2329008357.synopsis: Enslaved by the Alpha who slaughtered her family, Lyra is forced to the altar until his son Asher kills him and claims her. Their fated bond ignites, but Asher hides her and takes political Luna Selene to shield her. Selene's jealousy explodes into brutal torture, forcing his cruelty to mask his devotion. When Selene and brother Garrick's coup erupts into war, Lyra reveals she is a lost Alpha's daughter and helps crush it, killing Garrick herself. Selene is exiled, and Lyra is crowned his equal.
6a962bb32b4cbe2329008357.title: The Alpha's Forbidden Mate

6a9631352b4cbe232900835a.synopsis: In my past life, my husband's niece drowned my newborn. To protect their precious heiress, the mafia family told me to let it go. When I refused, my own husband murdered me. Now, I’ve been reborn on the morning it all happened. This time, I secretly send my son to my father, the most powerful Mafia Godfather in the city. But when I return to the party, another baby still ends up in the pool. Predictably, my husband and his family rush to destroy the body to cover it up. Now there's just one question: whose child did their golden girl really kill?
6a9631352b4cbe232900835a.title: A Mother's Vengeance

6a963ba8fda5294962054f78.synopsis: Tessa is pushed off a building by her adopted sister Chloe. She wakes up at fifteen, reliving her life. This time, she refuses to fight for her family's love. Chloe manipulates everyone, framing Tessa for cheating. Tessa calmly proves Chloe's guilt using surveillance footage. Chloe is expelled. Tessa earns straight A's and a Yale scholarship. Her family apologizes, but she remains distant. She leaves for Yale alone, determined to live for herself.
6a963ba8fda5294962054f78.title: I Watched Them Love Her

6a96459a9521102b6f0c2bf8.synopsis: Delaney is the youngest daughter most beloved by the Dragon God, but she falls in love with a human named Dylan. As a test, the Dragon God seals Delaney’s divine powers for three years. During those three years, Delaney, a female CEO, helps Dylan’s company grow into a household-name corporation. To protect Dylan’s pride, she supports him quietly from behind the scenes. In the third year of their marriage, Delaney gives birth to a dragon egg that needs to be hatched, but Dylan becomes involved with Daphne, his secretary who is secretly his mistress. At an auction, Delaney crosses paths with Daphne and the two clash. The dragon egg, on the verge of hatching, becomes the target of Daphne’s jealous rage…
6a96459a9521102b6f0c2bf8.title: She Smashed My Dragon Baby, I Smashed Her Life

6a966a6a2b3144019f077a7f.synopsis: GT endurance driver Kai Mercer is pushed into a reserve role after refusing his sponsor’s sexual advances, while struggling with his father’s debts and his mother’s illness. Through an anonymous platform, Kai develops an intimate relationship with a mysterious man named Nox, unaware that Nox is actually Adrian Cross, his new team owner and a four-time World Endurance Champion. As Kai falls for both identities, Adrian’s secret creates a dangerous conflict of trust and power. When the truth is exposed, Kai walks away. After kidnappings, threats, professional investigations, and an ethics hearing, the two eventually rebuild their relationship, while Kai earns his place as a professional works driver.
6a966a6a2b3144019f077a7f.title: Below the Red Line

6a966b738b5041bbb80e1d41.synopsis: Desperate to pay for her sick mother’s treatment, restaurant waitress Anna is betrayed by her biological father, Richard, and sent into a deadly trap controlled by an East Side crime boss. Using her combat skills and intelligence, she survives, defeats Victor, and escapes with crucial evidence. With the help of Leo, an undercover operative and Thomas’s son, Anna rises through Los Angeles’ criminal underworld, taking control of casinos and territory. But she soon discovers that her entire rise has been part of Thomas’s larger power game. Together, Anna and Leo expose the money-laundering operation and bring down Thomas and Richard.
6a966b738b5041bbb80e1d41.title: Blood Rose Crushing the Cartel

6a967daf71807a57f7059e60.synopsis: Odysseus is the secret demigod son of Apollo, bound by a deathbed vow to give his queen, Antigone, a hundred chances to earn his trust — and never seize her throne. He turns white-haired overnight saving her kingdom from a monster, only to catch her in another man's arms. Stripped of power, tortured, framed, betrayed again and again — every wrong she commits burns away one more chance. When the hundredth chance runs out, his true power awakens. He returns for vengeance, spear blazing with divine fire — but victory comes at the ultimate price: his own existence.
6a967daf71807a57f7059e60.title: Demigod Under Oath

6a9786141e7b557da205265b.synopsis: Bullied university student Elena saves her mysterious professor, Lucien, from a deadly poison. Their fateful encounter leaves Elena pregnant with sextuplets—six baby dragons! Just as her abusive family and cruel classmates attempt to burn her alive for carrying "monsters," Lucien descends as a Black-and-Gold Dragon King to claim her as his Queen. However, Elena's rare ability to bear dragon heirs makes her the ultimate prize for the wicked Frost Dragon, Kael. Caught in a deadly war, can Elena awaken her true power and protect her family?
6a9786141e7b557da205265b.title: Pregnant with the Dragon King's Sextuplets

6a978afb992e4c583d089fdb.synopsis: Tim Harper is secretly Titan, but at school he's a bullied new kid. His powers keep nearly slipping out, and Sarah suspects his double life. Their bond grows through a talent show and a scholarship contest run by billionaire Blackwell, secretly Tim's mentor. Confessing his secret costs Tim his powers. Mayor Hunter and Jax frame him at a gala, and a blast nearly kills everyone. Powerless, Tim risks his life anyway, regains his powers, and flies off with Sarah as the villains are arrested.
6a978afb992e4c583d089fdb.title: World's Strongest Loser!

6a97cd86f09d793bab0603ad.synopsis: Born a commoner, Eleanor has spent years quietly protecting her husband, Duke Adrian, and his kingdom. Yet he has always mistaken her loyalty for ambition, believing she married him only for status and power. After being publicly humiliated and heartlessly cast aside by the man she loves, Eleanor finally gives up on their marriage and walks away. Only after she leaves does Adrian discover that the mysterious masked warrior who repeatedly saved his life was Eleanor all along. What he still does not know is that she is also the long-lost heir to a powerful empire. When Eleanor reclaims her identity and the power that rightfully belongs to her, Adrian finally realizes what he has lost. Meanwhile, an ambitious regent launches a coup, plunging the entire kingdom into crisis. With both his former wife and his realm in danger, Adrian is willing to sacrifice everything to protect Eleanor. But this time, he is no longer fighting to win back her love—only for the chance to earn her forgiveness.
6a97cd86f09d793bab0603ad.title: The Duchess They Cast Away

6a97fcd41810d9e05a02c5a5.synopsis: Nia is a 300-pound Omega mocked by the entire pack as a disgusting fat wolf. When Alpha Zayne chooses her as his Luna, she believes she has finally been loved. She poisons herself, bleeds for him, tears her own fur to keep him warm, and carries his child. Then she overhears the truth: Zayne only used her as a womb and plans to kill her after the baby is born. Betrayed, abused, and forced through unbearable trials, Nia awakens as a legendary White Wolf. Now she returns under a new name, not for love, but to save the child Zayne killed. The Alpha finally falls in love with her beauty, but the woman who once loved him has already died.
6a97fcd41810d9e05a02c5a5.title: After the 330-Pound Fat Wolf Left, the Alpha Went Crazy with Regret

6a97fe91ae5bf68c3c0ed5e7.synopsis: After catching her boyfriend cheating with her best friend at a college party, Vera accidentally falls into a pool and wakes up in Ancient Egypt. Branded an outsider and hunted for her mysterious origins, she's rescued by Prince Amon, who discovers she carries the blood of an ancient god. As a power-hungry queen plots to use Vera's divine bloodline to seize the throne, Vera and Amon are drawn into a deadly game of palace intrigue, betrayal, and forbidden love. Just when Vera finally finds a way back home, the person she trusts most is killed. Choosing revenge over escape, she embraces the godlike power within her—but the truth behind her bloodline could destroy everything Ancient Egypt was built on.
6a97fe91ae5bf68c3c0ed5e7.title: Bound to the Pharaoh

6a98116575e068605f0b3cf7.synopsis: Aria, a human teenage girl, suddenly finds herself homeless after her family goes bankrupt. She's forced to live in her car, a shameful secret she needs to hide from the vicious bullies at her elite private high school. One day, she discovers that she's the mate of both Damon, the werewolf heir, and Levi, the vampire prince. These two supernaturally handsome boys have opposite personalities. One as passionate as fire, and the latter as cold as ice. Which one is her true love? Aria later discovers that there's more to her real identity than she thought. It's a secret that could destroy everything.
6a98116575e068605f0b3cf7.title: Bound by Crimson and Silver

6a9813f417879200f002d8ca.synopsis: Falsely condemned to bear only lowly mongrels, Moonwolf she‑wolf Aurora is viciously harmed by her husband and clan leader Tristan. Reborn on the day of the political marriage, she hears the hateful prophecy again and watches Tristan wed her sister to produce a noble Silverwolf. On a full‑moon night, Aurora slips into Moonillusion Bar and surrenders herself to the trapped, heat‑stricken ancient wolf god Fenrir for a child. Their fiery night frees Fenrir from his thousand‑year bonds. He shocks everyone by claiming the pregnant Aurora as his bride. She delivers a supreme wolf king. Her powerful bloodline erases every disgrace. The traitor and her scheming sister kneel in defeat. Aurora changes her fate and gains unmatched glory.
6a9813f417879200f002d8ca.title: I Gave Birth to the Strongest Alpha Werewolf King

6a98d9755972ce3f4d0efdb8.synopsis: Silas was the world's greatest magician—a masked vigilante called the "King of Magic." When an assassin's bullet meant for him killed his mentor, Silas vowed to vanish and protect the man's daughter, Lyra. Now hiding as a janitor at Lyra's failing theater, he silently guards her and her little girl. But her vicious ex, her greedy uncle, and a parade of elite magicians descend to seize everything—forcing her into deadly magic duels where losing means death. One by one, Silas steps from the shadows. Whispers spread: could this lowly janitor be the missing King of Magic himself?
6a98d9755972ce3f4d0efdb8.title: American Magician: The Last Encore

6a99555185913218590748f3.synopsis: Orphaned Caine spent ten years protecting his foster father Alpha's five daughters, believing they were his destined mates. However, the arrival of Seth, a manipulative rogue wolf, shatters his world. Blinded by Seth's deceit, the five sisters turn against Caine, relentlessly humiliating him and stripping away his honor and sacred armor to appease the rogue. Pushed to the brink of despair by the family he once loved, Caine faces a turning point at his Ascension Ceremony. Will the powerful warrior continue to endure their cruel betrayal, or will he sever their fated bonds to claim a greater destiny?
6a99555185913218590748f3.title: Rejecting My Five Female Mates

6a9a22922dffdf54e50ba5a5.synopsis: In Accidentally His The Dragon King Won't Let Go movie, on a Blood Moon night, a drunken human girl steps into a cabin where the Dragon King lies in heat. After a steamy night with him, her belly suddenly swells, terrifying her into fleeing and leaving the loyal Dragon King to believe she has abandoned him. Days later, fate brings them together again, only for him to discover that she remembers nothing about him! But wait... is she secretly raising a child with horns all by herself?
6a9a22922dffdf54e50ba5a5.title: Accidentally His: The Dragon King Won't Let Go

6a9a2a1759516005be053227.synopsis: Alice is swept into the undersea world of Atlantis and becomes the mute, wicked supporting character everyone despises: the disgraced princess whose four merman husbands are ready to kill her. A healing pearl regrows her tongue, and the newly activated system sends her on missions to recover her beautiful voice and rebuild her spirit power. Through singing and other spirit-based purification skills, Alice eases the ocean corruption driving her husbands berserk and slowly turns their resentment into trust, affection, and fierce devotion. Soon, Gunnar the shark warrior, Will the irresistible merman, Vincent the sharp-tentacled octopus, and Albert the venomous jellyfish mage - four stunning, chiseled merman husbands - are all competing to protect and spoil her. When a two-faced rival tries to take everything Alice has reclaimed, she gives her enemy a satisfying reality check, turns the tables, and rises from Atlantis’s most unwanted woman to its most adored.
6a9a2a1759516005be053227.title: Spoiled by Four Sea Monster Husbands

6a9a62c047b73c93ed010ce8.synopsis: Mira is the long-lost biological daughter of the Hale family of Ashen City. Yet after returning home, she repeatedly gives way to their adopted daughter, Lia—surrendering her room, her place as a dragon rider, and even half of her mother’s inheritance. Before the wedding, Draegoth—the bonded dragon Garrick personally tamed and the only keepsake Mira has left from her mother—is trained to obey Lia alone and nearly kills Mira. Realizing that Garrick, her fiancé of eight years, has always seen her as nothing more than a gullible woman, Mira walks barefoot across burning coals, breaks off their engagement, and turns to marry Theron, the Lord of the North, who has waited eight years for her. When Garrick, Lia, and Mira’s brother Cael arrive at the magnificent Northern wedding and discover that Mira is the bride, they are overwhelmed with regret—but it is already too late. In the end, Mira is surrounded by the love she deserves, and her mother’s dragon finally returns to her side.
6a9a62c047b73c93ed010ce8.title: Goodbye My Ex, I'm Marrying the Dragon Prince FINAL

6a9a62f26495d8525209847f.synopsis: Kind-hearted Isabella always believed that being useful meant being loved. On the night she planned to propose to her boyfriend, she catches him cheating with her boss. Heartbroken and drunk, she stumbles into the hotel room of Owen—her company's cold, wealthy CEO, who's been drugged in a business trap. One night leaves her pregnant, binding two strangers in a marriage of convenience. What starts as distrust slowly becomes real. But when Owen's glamorous ex Lisa returns, she fuels Isabella's insecurities, convincing her she'll never truly have his heart. After a devastating accident, Owen believes their baby has died—while Isabella disappears with their son. Five years later, a stronger Isabella returns. Owen discovers the truth: she kept his child from him. Forced back into each other's lives, they must face old wounds, buried feelings, and Lisa's schemes—before they can finally choose love and become the family they were always meant to be.
6a9a62f26495d8525209847f.title: One night with my billionaire CEO

6a9a9f24146dc32fdc02e4c9.synopsis: Diana, the Wolf Queen, grew tired of war and bloodshed. She disguised herself as a simple healer in the woods. To give her daughter Katherine a normal life, she sent her to the Conroy pack. Little did she know, it was a living nightmare. The Conroy pack treated Katherine like a worthless slave—humiliated, abused, beaten, and nearly raped, simply because she had no power. When Diana discovered the truth, her motherly fury was unleashed. As the dark secrets of the Conroy pack’s betrayal of Lord Julius Redblood came to light, it was no longer possible to hide. The Wolf Queen had to strike back, defeat her enemies, and reclaim her crown.
6a9a9f24146dc32fdc02e4c9.title: The Wolf Queen Strikes Back

6a9aa0e1879a1f7da603a46b.synopsis: Abe Tatum is a transmigrator and a Great Emperor. But all he wants is a peaceful life and hides his true strength at the Azure Cloud Peak. Too bad his system forces him to take in three misfits——a reincarnated Empress, a troublemaker, and a girl with massive bad luck. He wants to keep a low profile, but keeps getting dragged into conspiracies, revenge, and heavenly karmic backlash. When his home and disciples face absolute peril, Abe Tatum is forced to drop his act.
6a9aa0e1879a1f7da603a46b.title: My Strongest Master Likes Acting Weak

6a9ab541307b23911801c401.synopsis: After she supports him through law school, Vicente dumps her. His reason? He found a rich girl to marry! Heartbroken, Abril marries a stranger... only to discover he is the billionaire CEO Cristóbal Noriega!
6a9ab541307b23911801c401.title: Flash Marriage to the Wild Billionaire

6a9b046ef7be38ef68007d67.synopsis: Ten years ago Layla's parents died pulling Elias Cole out of a burning building. She watched it happen, and the trauma took all five of her senses. Sight came back. Hearing and speech never did. Elias learned sign language for her and made her a promise: he'd be her eyes, her ears, her voice, and show her the whole world. The Coles raised her. The whole school knew whose girl she was. Then a transfer student named Molly turns the school into a game, and in the boys' bathroom Layla's hearing comes back — just in time to learn that Elias has been on the other side of that game for a long time. She says nothing. She lets them keep talking, keep escalating, keep filming, while a recorder collects every voice, every insult, every line about a cripple who can't call for help. She takes the beatings, the wastewater tank, the broken ribs, and she keeps the file. Molly is going to hear her own voice played back to her. And when Elias finally turns around and starts breaking things to make it up to her, Layla will already be on a plane, with an uncle who has been waiting ten years for her call, learning to say her first word out loud.
6a9b046ef7be38ef68007d67.title: All the Words I Never Said

6a9e332e7eb2800e7e0b27c9.synopsis: Ethan, the cursed Alpha of Silver Moon, needs a Luna who can survive bearing his heir. Hope, a poor outland Omega, enters the mate selection to save her pack — and accidentally awakens ancient wolf power. Forced into a bond, Ethan rejects her at first. But when Hope risks her life for him, hate turns into obsession. Now they must break the Luna curse before their mate bond kills her.
6a9e332e7eb2800e7e0b27c9.title: The Heirless Alpha's Miracle Omega

6a9fa3ff72bf93a3100ed278.synopsis: Kallydia, head priestess of the Temple of Philotia, is exploited by her mother—forced to seduce the Sun God Helios for gold coins. An enchanted incense leads to a night with him. She flees at dawn, leaving only a silver armband engraved with her name. Helios had grown fond of her—but after a misunderstanding, he believes she's just a social climber who toys with men. Enraged, he cuts all contact. Kallydia discovers she's pregnant. Alone, she guards the faint golden light in her womb through public humiliation and family oppression. The God of War and Goddess of Wisdom arrive, revealing the truth: the gentle maidservant they remember is the "bad woman" Helios spoke of. By the time Helios reaches her, Kallydia has been tortured bloody and cast into a pit of serpents. With her last breath, she begs the gods to protect her child.
6a9fa3ff72bf93a3100ed278.title: The Sun God’s Beloved

6a9fa78372bf93a3100ed27c.synopsis: Damon Blackwood, the ruthless mafia don who has never touched a woman at thirty, mistakes innocent college student Lily for an escort during a rainstorm. After one brutal night, he casts her out with a priceless watch. One month later, Lily discovers she is pregnant with twins—but her drug-addicted brother's debts force her parents to sell her to a dealer. Seven months later, she collapses in Damon's own bar, and the Patek Philippe on her wrist reveals the truth: she is the virgin he destroyed. When Damon learns his own heirs are dying inside her, the beast becomes a prisoner of love. He brings her to his estate, quits whiskey and cigars, buys out entire department stores, and crashes through windows to protect her from bullies. From a blood-soaked underworld to a sunlit chapel, this is the story of a soulless killer who learns to kneel, and a broken girl who learns she is worth more than diamonds.
6a9fa78372bf93a3100ed27c.title: The mob boss spoils his pregnant wife

6aa0bd39fc29657998080be1.synopsis: After the sudden death of her father, Charlotte is cruelly abused by her succubus stepmother and two stepsisters. At an elven banquet, the Orc Queen arrives to choose a new bride with a magical goblin. After being secretly framed by her stepsister, Charlotte is chosen by the goblin and taken back to the orc castle as a “bargaining chip.” She is ordered to choose between two orc princes and marry one of them at her 18th birthday ceremony. At Saint Elaine’s Supernatural Academy, Charlotte meets two orc princes with completely opposite personalities: Vesper, an aloof, restrained snake prince with dark hair, and Claude, a charismatic, sunshine-bright lion prince with golden hair. As her stepsisters Skyler and Blair relentlessly torment her at school and the lecherous hyena Logan repeatedly schemes against her, the two princes transform into fiercely protective mates. They publicly declare Charlotte as theirs in front of the entire school, and time and again, they unleash their full beast forms—the Golden Berserker Lion and the Black-Armored Giant Serpent—to rescue her from danger. As they spend more time together and their intertwined fates pull them deeper into one another’s lives, Charlotte finds herself torn between the possessive, jealous Vesper and the gentle, devoted Claude. Caught between their overwhelming affection, she gradually falls hopelessly in love with both. On the eve of her coming-of-age ceremony, she even takes the final step with Vesper inadvertently awakening the rare and supreme bloodline of the “Holy Elf,” an ancient elven lineage of unparalleled power.
6aa0bd39fc29657998080be1.title: The Elf Bride’s Impossible Choice

6aa0bec90b22d50efa081ac4.synopsis: Will O'Connell, the city's most powerful mafia boss, dies saving an overweight, bullied teenager, Cayden, only to awaken in the boy's body. Forced back into high school, Will quickly clashes with campus bully Dane. After enduring a brutal public beating, he shocks everyone by knocking Dane down with a single punch. With help from his trusted confidant Vinny, Will secretly regains control of the O'Connell family while posing as his own illegitimate son. Using mafia resources, he transforms Cayden's body, returns to school in spectacular fashion, humiliates Dane, defeats a vindictive teacher with his academic brilliance, and survives an assassination attempt.
6aa0bec90b22d50efa081ac4.title: Bully Me? I Run the Mob!

6aa0c32f740c3351330796a2.synopsis: Layla Hale, a fallen heiress, scrapes by working at a small‑town bakery with her twin sons, who can shift into wolf cubs. She endures harassment from her lecherous boss and constant hunger, until her best friend signs her up for the Voss Group Jewelry Competition. She returns to New York and wins the championship through her own talent. Yet barely after lifting the trophy, she is framed by her malicious adopted sister Maggie, who had wronged her in the past. Layla is forced down onto a chair at City Hall and made to take Maggie’s place in marrying the notorious CEO of Voss Group — a man rumored to be hideously ugly, brutal and perverse. When the door swings open, however, the man who steps forward is none other than the one who marked her five years ago — the biological father of her two wolf‑cub sons. What she does not know is that the man she has spent five years running from has spent those same five years searching for her. — Fled with my kids for five years, only for my toxic sister to force‑marry me to the Wolf King CEO — who happens to be my boys’ real father.
6aa0c32f740c3351330796a2.title: The Alpha King Is My Baby’s Daddy!

6aa0cc0c8ee9b4536c0e27de.synopsis: Exploited and sold off by her adoptive family, reborn genius Scout uses DNA matching to reunite with her biological father—Dominic Moretti, America’s supreme Mafia don. Backed by three elite brothers, she debuts as the sole Moretti heiress at her coming-of-age gala, exposes her abusers, and claims her place at the top.
6aa0cc0c8ee9b4536c0e27de.title: My Second Life as a Billionaire Heiress

6aa0e4992d54042dab0172a6.synopsis: On her 7th anniversary, pregnant Amelia finds husband Trevor dining with another woman. She leaves Boston, files for divorce using a prenup clause he wrote, and reclaims her hidden identity as Dr. Amelia Voss—co‑founder of Longmoor Labs and creator of VESL. As she rebuilds her career and custody of daughter Adi, Trevor’s world crumbles. With support from her grandmother, loyal colleagues, and quiet suitor Hugh, Amelia wins sole custody, 75% assets, and a new life. Trevor loses everything—too late, he finally sees who she truly is.
6aa0e4992d54042dab0172a6.title: I Flew Home Pregnant Only To See His Secret

6aa14b83871c17602008654b.synopsis: My family never remembered my birthday. Ethan’s meant a steakhouse booked a month ahead; Chloe’s meant Six Flags and Mom’s Instagram carousel: “Happy birthday to our little princess.” Mine is July 19th, mid-summer—always ignored. On my eighteenth, I woke early, put on makeup, and waited on the couch. Mom passed with Chloe’s dance bag: “Heat your own lunch. I’m taking her to intensive.” Dad left with Ethan to play ball. By noon I was alone. I texted the family chat: “I’m eighteen today! 🎉” Silence. At seven they came home—Ethan’s ribs, Chloe’s mac and cheese. No cake. No candles. No song. Nothing missing, to them. Everyone got a birthday except me. I was eighteen now. I could finally choose where to go.
6aa14b83871c17602008654b.title: You Ignored My Birthday So I Erased Myself From The Family

6aa2199faf0e20bdc4094519.synopsis: Five years ago, gifted surgeon Elara Voss fled a suffocating marriage while secretly carrying her husband’s unborn daughter. Now, one drunken mistake lands her back in bed with her cold, billionaire ex‑husband, Damian Sterling. Determined to protect their five‑year‑old daughter, Elara insists the child isn’t his and proposes a strictly physical arrangement: Tuesdays only, no publicity, no interference, and no entanglement. What she doesn’t know is that Damian has loved her for five full years and waited for her all along; he simply never knew how to express his feelings. As old desire reignites, their daughter’s identity and the carefully staged fake‑infidelity hoax that destroyed their marriage begins to surface. Can two people who never learned to understand each other’s love give their marriage a second chance once the truth comes to light?
6aa2199faf0e20bdc4094519.title: My Possessive Ex-Husband

6aa24b86d6c23093cf06e859.synopsis: After three years of hidden trial in a homeless camp, Vince Astor is crowned America's Godfather, heir to $20.9 billion. He keeps the secret when Helen Stark, the CEO he saved two years ago, proposes to him on the street. Still dressed as a bum, he follows her home and swallows her family's scorn as they force her to marry Philip West. His power then surfaces layer by layer. A bank president kneels, a $1 billion bid lands, an underboss kisses his ring. Helen chooses him anyway, for who he is.
6aa24b86d6c23093cf06e859.title: Step Back! That Homeless Man Is Not to be Messed with

6aa25a957520bcf44103332b.synopsis: On her wedding day, Orton Reed is abandoned, slapped, and humiliated in front of everyone, all because her fragile stepsister Lucy is having another crisis. Her fiancé Cole, her childhood friend Ryan, and even her biological parents all choose Lucy over her. After discovering she is seriously ill, Orton finally stops begging to be loved. She leaves New York for a remote school in New Mexico, where she teaches, heals, and learns to live for herself. When the people who hurt her come back with apologies, Orton no longer wants a place in their lives.
6aa25a957520bcf44103332b.title: I'm Done Playing Along

6aa35dfd4d5aaf051600f537.synopsis: Laura, sold to a violent old man, escapes into a cave and bonds with silver dragon duke Kyle—becoming pregnant with his heir. They marry for the child, then fall in love. Despite rival schemes and assassination attempts, Laura discovers runemaster talent, gives birth to twins, founds an academy, and stands equal beside Kyle.
6aa35dfd4d5aaf051600f537.title: Becoming the Heirless Dragon King's Fated Mate

6aa361dabb9c46cea20e79f9.synopsis: I was dying from a difficult childbirth, yet my husband stayed outside the delivery room of his subordinate’s widow. I signed the divorce papers and left without hesitation. He was filled with deep regret and ended up abandoned by everyone around him.
6aa361dabb9c46cea20e79f9.title: I Signed My Divorce Papers on the Operating Table
